courses.2238:
Loughborough University's Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Mathematics provides a balanced study of the most important aspects of mathematics so that students can achieve a thorough understanding of the fundamentals to help prepare them for a successful career.

Mathematics is an exciting subject which is not only fascinating to study in its own right but also underpins a great variety of endeavors such as science, commerce and industry. A mathematics degree is actively sought by employers and opens many doors to subsequent employment and further study. Its study gives students the numerical abilities, logical thinking and analytical skills that are crucial to the success of diverse organizations within commerce, banking and finance, management an industry. Through innovative teaching the department equips its students with these skills while also opening up the many facets of this rich and stimulating discipline.

Over the first two years of the program students will study the core aspects of mathematics, including analysis, linear algebra, geometry, probability and statistics, complex variables, mechanics and calculus of variations. In the final year students will undertake an individual project or report, and choose from wide-ranging options spanning pure and applied mathematics, enabling them to tailor the course to their particular interests.
courses.2276:
The Master of Science in Construction Project Management with Sustainability is uniquely dedicated to developing construction managers’ knowledge and expertise in sustainable practices, focusing on the integration of sustainable design and construction processes across a building life cycle.

Managing construction has become inexorably intertwined with sustainability. The requirement for construction managers to have expertise in environmental engineering, building physics, sustainable design, and the commissioning and testing of sustainable buildings is fundamental to practical decision-making and professional judgements.

This programme addresses critical global challenges by integrating contemporary construction management theory and practice with fundamental and interrelated sustainable design and construction. Students will benefit from hands-on experience and knowledge to deepen their expertise for application within the public or private sector.

The School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering is one of four Royal Academy of Engineering Centres of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, and one of the most highly funded built environment groups by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC). The School hosts the Building and Industrial Services Pipework Academy (BISPA), which is a collaboration with global steel manufacturer Tata Steel and the Chartered Institution of Building Services Engineers (CIBSE). This uniquely holistic view of construction makes it best placed for developing graduates that meet the increasing demands of the sector.
courses.2510:
The University of Essex MA Curating offers a practical and theoretical training in devising and curating exhibitions, as students work towards the preparation of an exhibition at Essex's on-site Art Exchange gallery.

Essex's course combines practice, theory and histories of curating in equal measure. Students will develop essential base skills for a successful exhibition – from object handling to managing exhibition budgets – through visiting lectures by active museum professionals; practical workshops using the on-site collection and galleries; and competitive placements at leading institutions. Previous students have worked at the V&A, Royal Academy of Arts, Hayward Gallery and Firstsite Gallery.

Students will build their own confident grasp of the history and theory of exhibition-making, studying with academics who besides being active curators are producing new key texts on the curatorial history and theory. Students study topics including: how an exhibition can be used as a means of social and political critique, the historical role that museums have played in society, participation and social engagement between spectators, artists and curators, and a choice of history of art options.

Essex is ranked 6th among Art History departments in the UK for research excellence.

MA Curating with Professional Placement offers a unique opportunity for students to gain relevant work experience within an external business or organization, giving them a competitive edge in the job market and providing them with key contacts within the industry. The placement is undertaken between the taught part of the course and the individual project. Its aim is to allow students to acquire industry experience and, especially, develop an appreciation of how the skills acquired in the taught part of the course can be applied to real world work.

Students are responsible for securing their own work placement, but if they change their mind and decide not to do their placement, or if students are not able to secure a placement, they can start their dissertation earlier and complete their Masters in the first year.

The visual arts and culture industries have become an increasingly significant part of the national and international economy, and Essex's art history graduates leave Essex with the skills to take advantage of this growing opportunity.

Graduates from Essex's programmes are ideally prepared for roles in the media, in advertising, in museums and galleries, in education (in schools, universities, and cultural institutions), as conservators, as auctioneers, dealers and antiques specialists, in charities, in publishing, as specialist arts lawyers, as PR agents, in fashion, or to run their own galleries.

Recent graduates have gone on to work for a wide range of high-profile companies including: National Portrait Gallery, Victoria and Albert Museum, Sotheby's New York, Momart Ltd, and John Lewis.
courses.2529:
In recent years, issues of terrorism and organized crime have gained an unprecedented profile, provoked significant social concern, and dominated both law-and-order and many wider social policy agendas. The University of Essex MA Organised Crime, Terrorism and Security course draws on state-of-the-art research to address key critical issues surrounding organized criminality and terrorism in contemporary society.

Essex involves multi-level analyses of organized crime as a concept, alongside the impacts of urbanization, migration and globalization upon both the practice of crime and the ways in which humans understand them. Students will address cutting-edge critical, conceptual and theoretical analyses of terrorism and counter-terrorism.

This course provides students with a strong grounding in the key theories, understandings and issues relating to organized crime and terrorism. Students explore topics including: globalization and organized crime; mafia, corruption and power; drug trafficking and illicit trades; security and the state; analysis, politics and prevention of terrorism; ethics of human rights; the hacker ethics.

Many staff members have worked at the local level with local authorities, justice councils, community partnerships and charities. Others have worked at a national and international level with bodies like the United Nations, the European Commission’s Expert Group on Public Understanding of Science, Amnesty International, The Royal College of Pediatrics and Child Health, the Home Office and national non-governmental organizations.

This course provides excellent preparation for further academic study, and many of Essex's postgraduates go on to successful academic careers, both in the UK and overseas.

Employment opportunities for graduates of this course include careers in security, policing, research, intelligence and justice professions. Others have established careers in non-governmental organizations, local authorities, specialist think tanks, government departments, charities, media production, and market intelligence.
courses.5176:
Foundation is an entry point that comes before the first year of university. By studying a foundation, students will gain a solid understanding of their chosen subject as well as the required skills for study at a UK university. Upon successful completion of foundation, they will progress directly to first year or to international year one

This degree provides valuable insight into the worlds of accountancy practice, commerce, industry and finance. Teaching is delivered through a blend of lectures, workshops, field trips and online learning. During the course, students will gain expertise in the following areas:

  • Financial and management accounting
  • Corporate finance
  • International accounting and finance issues
  • Data analysis
  • Business technology.
courses.5399:
London Metropolitan University's Master of Architecture RIBA 2 course is design-driven and will enable students to focus their skills and develop excellence in their work. The main areas of study are in design, technology, practice, history and theory. Each area is taught by a wide range of tutors, with a strong emphasis on self-directed study and ambitious agendas.

The MArch Architecture RIBA 2 course as a whole encourages fresh thinking, experimentation and risk. Students will be encouraged to understand and engage with the society they are part of and to engage with social, political and economic infrastructures that predetermine built form.

Students will benefit from the course's central London location and its proximity to internationally renowned creative and industry hubs. The School’s extensive networks encourage students to expand their knowledge and skills through lectures, events and careers advice, leaving students with excellent career prospects.

An International Bright Futures Scholarship in the amount of £3,000 will automatically be applied to eligible students with overseas fee status starting a degree with London Met in the 2024/25 academic year. This scholarship includes a tuition fee reduction for the duration of students' studies and is applicable to both undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Tuition Deposit is £4,000 for all students excluding those from Punjab and Haryana for whom the deposit amount will remain at 50%
courses.6140:
Program Description

In a challenging and complex economic climate, there is an ever-increasing demand for reflective, entrepreneurial and responsible business leaders with the necessary skills, understanding and acumen to tackle the difficult challenges facing organisations of all sizes. Teesside University's MBA is designed to develop and enhance students' strategic leadership skills to manage this demand.

Students explore topics that will enhance their knowledge of key concepts as well as having the opportunity to directly apply skills to add value to the workplace or, for those studying full time with us, add value by working on real-time projects with Teesside's partners, contributing to the organization and enhancing their own development.

By studying this MBA, students not only gain an internationally renowned qualification but they will develop entrepreneurial and leadership skills to make an immediate impact in the workplace. If students aspire to make a significant contribution to their organization and society more generally by leading at a strategic level, this is the course for them.
courses.7725:
Thought-provoking. Diverse. Flexible. Based in Chester, the famous walled city, the Business School is nestled on the banks of the stunning River Dee. This MBA offers students the chance to build their global network, test their creativity, challenge their perceptions and develop the management skills for international corporate success.

  • Students can tailor an MBA to their career requirements with a wide range of electives.
  • Create their global professional network with peers from across the globe with diverse student group.
  • The MBA is a career-changing learning experience. Students will invest in their future and realise their potential.

Chester Business School is an award winning Business School. This MBA programme provides students with a firm foundation in core business principles while developing a broadened outlook and understanding of the role of business in the world. Students will be challenged to explore the areas that interests them the most and gain the strategic skills and insight to start a successful career.
courses.7840:
Biomedical Science is an exciting, interdisciplinary subject exploring the normal functioning of the human body at the molecular, cellular and whole organism levels and how understanding these processes enables breakthroughs in the treatment of human disease and improvements to health.

Placing significant emphasis on laboratory techniques and scientific communication from writing labs reports, critical evaluation of scientific data and solving research problems, this biomedical science course provides essential skills required for a wide range of scientific careers.
courses.7842:
This degree allows students to specialise in business logistics and supply chain management in sectors such as retail, service, manufacturing and fashion. They will study modules in processes and value chains, project management, economics and international purchasing.

This programme helps to meet a demand for qualified personnel who can efficiently source and buy materials and resources. Our graduates have gone on to roles in buying, procurement and logistics in companies such as KPMG, ASDA and Ford.
courses.9195:
The MBA with Specialism in Business Analytics course provides a progression route to Master's level for those who have completed a first degree and who wish to continue with their professional development at an advanced level.

At the core of our course is a focus on how best to enable learners to develop advanced capabilities and understanding to make a significant contribution to business and/or professional objectives. Learning opportunities will address the contemporary and future challenges and issues faced by managers, including: the influx of innovative technologies and digital narratives; diversity and difference; sustainable initiatives; anticipating and creating change; changing demographics and employee expectations; evolving customer/client expectations; the need for intergenerational collaboration; working in flatter organisations and individualisation, staying agile and being ambidextrous.

For effective learning to take place, we implement the concept of the 'reflective practitioner', where we draw on the differing experiences of participants and tutor team as a resource.

This takes place through a systematic process of study, reflection and consideration, to optimise the benefits of learning. Learners will be encouraged to engage in dialogue and discussion and share their ideas and current work experiences with others in the group. The 'process' will involve a range of approaches to facilitate learning, including:

  • dialogue; focusing on a topic or group of related ideas to improve understanding
  • advising; by offering perspective on a best course of action or the nature of the situation
  • viewpoint; offering a range of points of view or standpoints.

It is expected that learners will engage with the curriculum to lead them to new ways of thinking, to evaluate and develop insights and sound analytical and management skills and then, where appropriate, to apply the skills and knowledge they acquire on the course by transferring and applying them to the workplace. Assignments are therefore designed to reflect this with learners usually encouraged to work on 'real life' problems/issues from their own workplace, which requires an ability to apply theoretical concepts in practice.

courses.9431:
The MSc Management and International Business degree at Birmingham City University is designed to equip students with the essential skills and attributes required to become effective international managers. Accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI), the course develops students’ ability to make strategic and tactical business decisions, understand cultural differences in global contexts, and manage and motivate teams across international organisations.

Throughout the programme, students work collaboratively in diverse, international teams on projects that mirror real-world professional practice. These projects involve producing reports and presentations as part of module assessments, helping students build practical skills. The course team provides ongoing support to help students develop their knowledge, confidence, and career readiness.

In the first stage of the course, students explore key challenges faced by global businesses, gaining insight into the complexity of leadership and management. This stage focuses on developing organisational, communication, and teamwork skills, particularly within culturally diverse environments.

In the second stage, students examine international operations management alongside corporate social responsibility, sustainability, and innovation. They also study international strategy and enhance their research skills in preparation for their final project.

The final stage consists of a Major Project tailored to individual career goals. Students can choose from three options: a work-based study linked to a current employer, a consultancy project addressing a real international business problem for a client, or a traditional dissertation involving in-depth research. This flexibility allows students to specialise in areas aligned with their career ambitions. Previous projects have explored topics such as international marketing strategy, global supply chain management in the food industry, and sustainability in cotton sourcing.
courses.9433:
The MSc Computer Science programme is a conversion course designed to provide students with a broad and balanced introduction to the field. It aims to prepare graduates for technical roles within the IT industry by developing the key knowledge and skills required for employment.

The course offers practical experience with contemporary models, techniques, and tools that underpin innovation in software-based systems. Core areas of study include software development using industry-relevant programming languages, software analysis and design for complex systems, database design and development, full-stack web application development, and the fundamentals of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

In addition, students develop essential academic and professional skills such as research methods, academic writing, and project management. These are further applied and consolidated through the completion of an independent dissertation.

As a conversion programme, the course is designed for students with little or no prior experience in computer science. It provides structured support to facilitate a smooth transition into the discipline and to build confidence in both technical and theoretical aspects of the subject.
courses.4ngd:
The world of enterprise is constantly adapting and evolving. The impact of changes in the business environment in terms of economic events, changes in accounting practices, changes in the regulatory and legal environment, marketing decisions, and the development of business strategies can make the difference between success and failure for a company. The BSc Business and Management, within the Aberystwyth Business School, is perfect preparation for students' career in the business world. The expert academics will guide students through areas of marketing, operations management, finance, accounting, strategy, human resource management and entrepreneurship - in addition to a range of other cutting-edge and specialist modules. The degree has been engineered for a student who wants to excel and succeed to the top level of global business management practice.

At Aberystwyth Business School, students will learn how to respond to these events by developing their knowledge of essential elements of business including human resource management, organisational behaviour, business strategy and operations, marketing, and business data analytics. The team of expert academics will develop students' understanding of management in business, trade and commerce in both the public and private sectors. During the course, students will develop awareness of the challenges facing management, and the combined impact of the economic, financial, human and legal issues that managers deal with on a daily basis. Students will also develop the skills to analyse management issues in relation to company priorities, external factors, and current good practice.

Opportunities for Business and Management students at Aberystwyth include:

  • working with businesses in the local community and further afield to develop their practitioner skills to support their academic development
  • learning from lecturers who have a wide range of business and management experience and research interests which are integrated into their learning.

After completing this degree, students will possess:

  • a broad understanding of management in practice
  • an in-depth knowledge of trade and commerce in both the public and private sector
  • a solid grasp in the complexity of management challenges and the combined impact of the economic, financial, human and legal issues that leaders encounter.
courses.4lyy:
The Bachelor of Laws (Honours) in Law course gives students the knowledge, skills and experience to pursue their career as a lawyer, journalist, activist, civil servant or in many other areas where a law degree is highly valued. The dedicated team of lawyers will provide them with in-depth knowledge of the contemporary legal issues that shapes lives and society. As well as developing their legal skills, the strong links with the legal profession and industry ensure exciting practical opportunities for ‘real world’ experiences to set them up for their chosen career.

The course is designed to foster students' intellectual independence. They will be supported to develop the confidence and skills needed to think critically, to ask and answer cogent questions about law and its role in society, and to effectively communicate their reasoned arguments, orally or in writing.
courses.4mfv:
The Bachelor of Laws (Honours) - Law - Criminology course gives students the knowledge, skills, and experience to pursue their passion for the law, while enabling them to explore issues relating to the criminal justice system such as policing, sentencing and offending. Bangor University's dedicated team of lawyers and criminologists will provide them with in-depth knowledge and understanding of the contemporary legal issues that shape lives and society. As well as developing their legal skills, the strong links with the legal profession and industry ensure opportunities for ‘real world’ experiences to set them up for their chosen career.

The course is designed to foster students' intellectual independence. They will be supported to develop the confidence and skills needed to think critically, to ask and answer cogent questions about law and its role in society, and to effectively communicate their reasoned arguments, orally or in writing. They will acquire new knowledge and understanding of the principles and values of law and justice.
courses.4mg3:
The Bachelor of Laws (Honours) - Law - Politics course allows students to gain an in-depth understanding of the contemporary legal and political issues that shape lives and society. Alongside learning the law, they will examine fundamental issues relating to power, justice, decision-making and social change. As well as developing their intellectual and legal skills, the strong focus on employability ensures exciting practical opportunities for ‘real world’ experiences to set them up for their chosen career.

The course is designed to foster students' intellectual independence. They will be supported to develop the confidence and skills needed to think critically, to ask and answer cogent questions about law and its role in society, and to effectively communicate their reasoned arguments, orally or in writing. They will acquire new knowledge and understanding of the principles and values of law and justice.
courses.4m8u:
Program Description

Accounting has been defined as the measurement and disclosure of financial information that is used by managers, investors and others to make decisions about the allocation of resources within organisations.

Accounting is much more than just the mechanical manipulation of financial data to produce company accounts. The methods for preparing accounting information must be applied with judgement, and with an understanding of the purposes for which the information will be used. A wide range of decision makers need to understand the key principles which underpin a cost or profit figure produced by an accountant.

By studying for a degree in Accounting and Finance, students will acquire skills that are central to the management of organisations, for measuring performance and maintaining the cash flows that are essential for the prosperity of any private company or public sector organisation.
courses.4lxb: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Banking and Finance program will allow students to develop specialist knowledge of the financial intermediaries, markets and institutions which lie at the heart of modern economies. They will learn about the roles that banks and central banks fulfil in providing credit and liquidity to the economy and in mitigating and managing risks. They will also learn about the ability of financial markets to satisfy similar roles. They will develop knowledge and skills which are highly valued by employers within the financial sector, which will provide a firm foundation for their future career.
courses.4m9l:
Program Description

This course has been specifically designed in collaboration with local NHS clinical laboratories and has been accredited by the Institute of Biomedical Science. Scientific and clinical staff from hospitals in North Wales will be heavily involved in all aspects of teaching and guest presentations will be given by international diagnostic companies.

Biomedical Science is concerned with the integration of a wide range of subjects that underpin the scientific investigation of human health and disease. This course is designed to give students essential knowledge and understanding of the biology of disease, including modern concepts and applications of biomedical science in the research, diagnosis and treatment of clinical disorders. Students are encouraged to assimilate knowledge from core biological sciences to develop skills in the more specialised biomedical disciplines of clinical biochemistry, cellular pathology, haematology and medical microbiology. There is a need for graduates who are experienced in the advanced diagnostic and molecular techniques that are revolutionising disease diagnosis and treatment in the NHS, Armed Forces, Industry, Academia and Research.
courses.8nhz:
The Business Data Analytics degree blends business acumen, technical proficiency, and practical skills in programming (R and Python), statistical learning, machine learning and data driven decision making.

Develop skills in logic, analysis, statistics, and maths, using industry-standard tools including Bloomberg terminals, CapitalIQ Pro, and R and Python programming languages.

At Bangor University, students will join a welcoming, close-knit community, which makes their learning experience more personal. Studying alongside students of different nationalities also offers international perspectives of the global economy.

The school regularly works with international institutions such as the European Central Bank (ECB), Bank for International Settlements (BIS), and policymakers in government, regulators, and the financial sector. Students will be taught by staff with real data analytics industry project experience.
courses.82ya:
The BSc (Hons) International Business Management prepares students to become a strategic problem-solver who can adapt to global business challenges. It provides broad and specialist understanding of business across the globe. The program gives them a greater understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing businesses who want to trade and/or operate overseas.

Students can take advantage of the ‘With Work Placement’ option, which offers the opportunity to undertake a year's work placement helping to prepare them for the graduate job market here in the UK and beyond.
courses.4ptr:
The International Year 1 (IY1), delivered at Bangor University International College (BUIC) provides an intensive combination of first year university subject's modules with extra study and English language skills. The IY1 is the first year of a three-year Bachelors degree.

At Bangor University International College (BUIC) the programmes are taught in small class sizes and it is able to offer small-group teaching, extensive tutor interaction and feedback, and enhanced English language tuition. This will help students improve both their subject knowledge and university study skills before progressing onto Bangor University.

Upon successful completion of the International Year 1 (IY1), students will continue to the second year of their chosen degree to study at Bangor University.

courses.93wc:
The BA (Hons) Business Management degree is designed to provide practical, skills-based learning that prepares students for a wide range of career opportunities within the dynamic and evolving world of business. The programme develops knowledge across core business and management functions, building confidence and enabling graduates to pursue careers in areas such as business consultancy, government, or entrepreneurship.

A strong emphasis is placed on emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, as well as employability and sustainability, ensuring students are well prepared for modern business environments. The course aims to develop adaptable, innovative, and agile professionals capable of responding to change and driving organisational success.

Students benefit from the use of an Assessment Centre that mirrors recruitment processes used by major organisations, helping them to develop key employability skills such as CV writing, interview techniques, and psychometric testing. The programme also supports entrepreneurial ambitions through dedicated modules, as well as access to business incubation and mentorship opportunities via STEAMhouse.

The course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI), providing students with industry-relevant knowledge and the opportunity to gain a professional certificate upon successful completion.

Teaching is delivered through interactive and experiential learning methods, including simulations and engagement with real-world business clients. Students develop skills in negotiation, data analysis, leadership, and project management, while also gaining an understanding of contemporary and international business markets. The programme explores key areas such as human resource management, finance, strategic planning, and cultural awareness, alongside the impact of digital transformation and the ethical considerations associated with modern business practices.

The course also offers an optional professional placement year, allowing students to gain valuable industry experience after completing their second year. Students are supported in securing placements through the university’s careers services and employer networks, and may transfer to the placement version of the course once a suitable opportunity is obtained.
courses.93we:
The BA (Hons) Business with Marketing course is designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to attract and retain customers, drive business growth, and remain competitive in a constantly evolving marketplace. It combines core business understanding with specialised marketing expertise, preparing students to apply strategic thinking and practical skills in real-world contexts.

The programme develops a broad range of competencies across both business and marketing disciplines, enabling students to make an immediate impact within organisations. Through innovative and experiential learning approaches, students gain expertise in areas such as business strategy, consumer behaviour, and integrated marketing communications, while also cultivating an entrepreneurial mindset to identify and capitalise on new opportunities.

A strong emphasis is placed on emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and data analytics, alongside key themes such as employability and sustainability. Students also have the opportunity to build a digital portfolio of certificates and accreditations, enhancing their professional profile and adaptability in a rapidly changing business environment.

The course provides a solid foundation in essential topics such as marketing principles, financial management, leadership, and business analytics, while offering flexibility through optional modules for further specialisation. It also explores the impact of digital transformation on business, including the ethical and social responsibilities associated with modern practices.

Overall, the programme prepares graduates for a wide range of career opportunities across large corporations, small and medium-sized enterprises, and entrepreneurial ventures, equipping them with the skills to succeed in diverse and dynamic industries.

The course includes an optional professional placement year, allowing students to spend a full year working with an employer after successfully completing their second year of study. This provides valuable insight into their chosen career and helps develop practical skills, with some students going on to secure long-term opportunities with their placement organisations after graduation.

Students who wish to undertake a placement are required to secure a role relevant to their field of study. They are supported throughout this process by the university’s careers services and can benefit from access to an extensive network of local, regional, and national employers. Once a suitable placement is secured, students can transfer onto the placement version of the course.
courses.93wh:
The BA (Hons) Digital Marketing degree is a two-year fast-track programme designed to immerse students in creative, real-world marketing and advertising practices. It combines strategic thinking with hands-on experience, enabling students to develop the skills required to succeed in the dynamic digital marketing industry.

The course offers a strong focus on collaboration with creative professionals, allowing students to work on simulated advertising campaigns and deliver innovative solutions for content-driven brands. Students gain practical experience using industry-standard tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud to produce engaging campaigns and digital content for a range of regional and national clients.

Delivered through an employment-led, practice-based approach, the programme integrates academic learning with real-world application. Tutors and industry professionals support students throughout lectures and assignments, helping them to develop both professionally and personally.

Based at the City Centre Campus, students participate in creative workshops, digital media production sessions, and collaborative projects within a modern learning environment. Teaching takes place in fully equipped production studios in central Birmingham, where students have access to dedicated studio space and professional software to support their work throughout the course.
courses.93wj:
The BA (Hons) Education Studies degree explores the role of education in shaping individuals and society, examining both theoretical and practical aspects of learning across the lifespan, from early childhood through to lifelong education.

The course encourages students to critically engage with the aims, values, and policies of education systems in the UK and internationally. Drawing on a multidisciplinary approach, it incorporates perspectives from psychology, sociology, law, history, philosophy, and politics to explore key issues and debates within education.

Central themes of the programme include the role of education in promoting social justice, equity, and inclusion; the impact of globalisation on education systems; and the influence of technological change on teaching and learning. This broad approach supports a comprehensive understanding of the evolving educational landscape.

Students also complete a practical placement during the second year, providing valuable experience within an educational setting and supporting the development of key employability skills.

The degree equips graduates with the knowledge, critical understanding, and professional skills required for a range of careers within education and related sectors.
courses.93x7:
The BA (Hons) Events Management degree is designed to prepare students for careers within the rapidly expanding global events and leisure industry. The programme develops the skills, knowledge, and practical experience needed to plan, manage, and deliver events across a range of contexts, from large-scale venues to individual projects.

Through immersive and hands-on learning, students engage with live briefs, real-world clients, and industry-focused projects. This approach enables them to gain practical experience in designing, organising, and managing events of varying scale and complexity.

The course provides opportunities to explore major event venues and operations, offering insight into how large-scale events are planned and delivered. Engagement with industry partners and guest speakers further enhances understanding of the sector, exposing students to current challenges, trends, and professional practices.

Employability is embedded throughout the programme, supporting students in developing the skills and experience required for careers in the events industry or for entrepreneurial pathways.

An optional professional placement year is available between the second and third years of study, providing valuable industry experience. Students are responsible for securing their placement, supported by the university’s careers services and employer networks. Those who successfully obtain a placement can transfer to the placement version of the course.

The degree equips graduates with the practical, organisational, and professional skills needed to succeed in the events and leisure sector.
courses.93wz:
The BA (Hons) Graphic Design degree is designed to develop the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to pursue a career within the creative industries. The course supports students in bringing their ideas to life through a combination of creative exploration, technical development, and critical thinking.

Students are guided by experienced academic staff, developing a range of design approaches and problem-solving techniques that prepare them for work in a dynamic and evolving field. The programme combines practical and intellectual skill development, ensuring graduates are equipped to respond to professional challenges.

In the first year, students focus on creative experimentation, building core design skills and an understanding of fundamental principles and practices. The second year introduces opportunities to work on live briefs, providing experience of real-world projects while advancing creative and technical abilities. In the final year, students develop independence in their practice, refining their critical approach and preparing for entry into the creative industries.

An optional professional placement year is available between the second and third years of study, offering valuable industry experience. Students are responsible for securing their placement, supported by the university’s careers services and employer networks. Those who successfully obtain a placement can transfer to the placement version of the course.

The programme equips graduates with the creative, technical, and professional skills required for careers in graphic design and related fields.
courses.93wx:

The course explores key aspects of people management, enabling students to build both theoretical understanding and practical competence in areas such as recruitment, development, performance management, and employee relations.

The programme reflects the evolving nature of the HR profession, incorporating contemporary practices and emerging technologies. Students have opportunities to engage with digital and immersive tools, including applications of virtual reality, in areas such as people analytics, recruitment and selection, training, onboarding, and performance management.

Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD), the course meets professional standards and supports progression within the HR field. A strong emphasis is placed on employability, with opportunities for both short-term and extended placements in the UK and internationally.

An optional professional placement year is available between the second and third years of study, providing valuable industry experience. Students are responsible for securing their placement, supported by the university’s careers services and employer networks. Those who successfully obtain a placement can transfer to the placement version of the course.

The programme equips graduates with the professional knowledge, practical skills, and industry awareness required for careers in human resource management and related areas.
courses.940p:
The BA (Hons) Marketing degree is designed to equip students with the knowledge and practical skills needed to succeed in a fast-paced and competitive business environment, where attracting and retaining customers is essential. As marketing continues to evolve alongside technological advancements and changing consumer behaviour, the course prepares students to identify opportunities, drive growth, and maintain business relevance.

Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM), the programme combines theoretical understanding with real-world application, enabling students to develop both professional expertise and the personal skills required by employers. A strong focus is placed on employability, sustainability, and emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, simulation, and data analytics, ensuring graduates are adaptable, innovative, and ready to contribute effectively in modern workplaces.

A key feature of the course is the opportunity to work with The Link Agency, a student-led, in-house marketing agency, where students gain hands-on experience by delivering live projects for real clients. Previous clients have included Bullring Shopping Centre, Acorns Children’s Hospice, and Solihull Moors FC.

Throughout the programme, students engage in practical learning through live campaigns, which may involve product launches, rebranding strategies, event promotion, or social media optimisation. Assessment is primarily based on coursework and project work, allowing students to demonstrate their skills through real-world applications rather than traditional examinations.

Students also have the opportunity to participate in The Pitch, a national competition organised by the Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM), where they apply their academic knowledge and creativity to real marketing challenges, further enhancing their employability.

The course includes an optional professional placement year, offering students the chance to gain valuable industry experience after their second year. With support from the university’s careers services and employer networks, students can secure placements aligned with their career goals and transfer to the placement version of the course once a suitable opportunity is obtained.
courses.5y63:
Program Description

Underpinned by long-standing and internationally recognized research in tourism and hospitality, this Bournemouth University degree is suitable for those with career aspirations related to global hospitality and the wider travel and tourism industry. It will provide students with an understanding of the origins, development and organization of the tourism and hospitality industries, and the opportunities and challenges facing organizations operating in and across the various sectors.

The accommodation sector continues to grow rapidly. Year after year, global revenues and occupancy rates have continued to increase, as have international passenger arrivals. Helping to sustain this growth means that many new jobs – as well as small and medium-sized enterprises – have been created in the accommodation, food and drink, transport, visitor attractions and travel distribution sectors.

Social and technological changes have created new opportunities in these markets, many of which are threats to the existing organizations. In order to succeed, businesses need managers that understand how to compete and collaborate with others in a dynamic and diverse group of industries.

Students will graduate with the skills those businesses are looking for through studying a combination of tourism and hospitality with a specific focus on international issues, students will learn what is needed not just to survive in such an environment, but to thrive in it.
courses.1tdh:
Program Description

This course is approved by Social Work England which means students will be eligible to apply for registration as a social worker on successful completion of the course, explaining why 95% of BU graduates are employed within six months of graduating.

Social workers practice in areas including child protection, fostering and adoption, adult safeguarding, mental health, substance use, hospital discharge and disability.

This practical degree, which is one of the top ten of its kind according to the 2018 Guardian League tables, blends a powerful combination of academic study with essential practical experience.

As a result, graduates will leave BU equipped with specialist knowledge and practical skills needed to deal with a broad range of issues such as social exclusion and discrimination, law and social policy, psycho-social development, models and methods of intervention and research methods.

Students will gain lots of relevant experience during their placements, operating in real-world settings. What’s more, they can even seize the opportunity to travel and engage in international activities.
courses.1krh:
Program Description

Whether you want to run your own business or aspire to become the manager of a large company, management roles are both challenging and rewarding. The BA (Hons) Business Management & Leadership course is designed to help students develop key leadership skills, from managing people and resources to strategic planning. The degree focuses on contemporary management issues, giving students the opportunity to develop a wealth of general skills needed to aid progression from an operational level through to leadership.

Success in this field requires confidence, versatility and strategic thinking, coupled with elevated communication skills and a desire to succeed.

Alongside award winning teaching, students get the chance to conduct critical research with the department's experienced staff, learn from highly-regarded guest visitors and take part in invaluable practical modules.

This course offers students the option to undertake a Professional Placement Year or Study Abroad Year. If they wish to do so, students can opt to take the Professional Placement Year module or the Study Abroad Year module which both typically run for a full academic year between years 2 and 3 of the course. Students are able to progress onto the relevant module if they have successfully completed the first two years of the course (i.e. having accumulated 240 credits) and provided that they confirm their interest in undertaking this option before the end of second year, typically in August.

While the Professional Placement Year and Study Abroad Year modules students undertake are non-credit bearing but do not incur any additional tuition fees, if successfully completed, these modules will appear on their final academic transcript. In addition, if they complete this year, they will also gain an enhanced degree award title as the additional suffix of “With Professional Enhancement” if they've gone on a work placement and “With International Enhancement” if they've gone on a study abroad program will be added ( subject to relevant assessments) .

The Talent Team can provide students with a wide range of support services in order to help them apply for a placement opportunity. Past students have worked with [Jaguar Land Rover, the Bugatti Trust and Imagination. Several students have had internships in London, Birmingham, Amsterdam, Berlin, Stuttgart and Bologna.

Please note that placement or study abroad opportunities are not guaranteed and that any such opportunities referred to on this webpage may be subject to additional costs (e.g. travel, visas and accommodation etc.), competitive application, availability and/or meeting any applicable visa requirements.

Many areas of management and leadership, such as the development of new concepts and modern project management, require graduates to have good theoretical and practical knowledge to control, implement and evaluate new developments.

This is an applied course and recognises the multidisciplinary approach that is needed in business leadership. Throughout their degree, students will study the details of operating markets, information technology and leadership practice, demonstrating a capability to maintain auditable records of their work.

They will be able to use various assessment tools and strategies to gather data, track individual progress, and make informed instructional decisions to support each child's development. The Financial Management and Accounting BA (Hons) degree aims to enable students to make a valid contribution to managerial and accounting functions of any organisation such as sole traders, firms of partnerships, private and public companies, and charitable organisations.

The first year of this degree course is concerned with the application of skills for identifying and recording financial transactions in accounts and ledgers following the principles of double entry bookkeeping, drafting and interpreting the financial statements of sole traders, partnerships and limited companies. Students will also acquire knowledge of information to be presented to users of the financial statements and how to apply the rules and principles established by international accounting standards (IAS and IFRS) to these financial statements. Year 2 of this course is concerned with providing the knowledge and skills of corporate finance, which forms the basis of investment analysis and decisions and enables students to undertake a variety of risk assessments relating to financial matters. Students should expect to understand the models of financial risk management and their application within a range of professional settings. The final year is concerned with students being able to evaluate the concept of compliance and assurance, why compliance is required and the reasons for assurance engagements being carried out by appropriately qualified professionals.

The Public Health and Community Studies BA (Hons) course aims to provide students with the underpinning theoretical knowledge, professional expertise and work-based learning relevant to a range of roles working in health and social care. The Public Health and Community Studies (Hons) degree has been designed to equip students with the knowledge, understanding and skills required to excel in a multidisciplinary community environment and to effectively support a variety of agencies, communities and individuals in promoting health and wellbeing. With increased attention from government on the improvement of population health, this is an excellent time to study the underlying factors that contribute to ill health and how students as practitioners can work to promote health and wellbeing as well as tackling the social inequalities within the localities they serve.

While the majority of graduates go directly into a public health profession, others have chosen to study further in the field, with several students undertaking a master’s degree in subjects such as Public Health and Nutrition, International Business Management and Social Policy.
courses.6f81:
Study Law at Canterbury Christ Church and join a challenging and vibrant community, led by an experienced team of academics and practitioners, including solicitors, barristers and international lawyers.

This Law degree will enable students to progress to the vocational stage of lawyer’s training, to qualify as either a solicitor or barrister. With a combination of theory and practice, this original and innovative degree in Law will effectively challenge students and give them the opportunity to develop vital and transferable skills needed for a future career in Law and beyond.

Canterbury Christ Church is one of only a few universities across the country which offers a dual qualification to those who choose to take this path: an LLB and Membership of the National Association of Licensed Paralegals. This means that students will graduate with a GradNALP in addition to their LLB, which will enable students to be an official paralegal.

The teaching staff are specialists in a wide range of areas. From human rights and artificial intelligence to corporate and medical, students will learn alongside experts, many of whom are still practising.

Students will also have the option to get involved with practical justice, including opportunities to shadow a local judge and experience live mediations from the in-house Mediation Clinic. This practice will certainly highlight their professional experience and understanding, which will enhance their overall skillset. Through the strong links with the local community, Citizens Advice and the local courts, students will have the opportunity to act as a Community Legal Companion for unrepresented parties at court. This is an excellent opportunity for students to gain hands-on work experience in a legal setting, which will set them up for the world of work post-graduation.
courses.6f8b:
This Law degree will enable students to progress to the vocational stage of lawyer’s training, to qualify as either a solicitor or barrister. This original and innovative course has been designed in consultation with senior managers to give students both a theoretical and practical experience.

The University is one of only a few universities across the country which offers a dual qualification: an LLB and Membership of the National Association of Licensed Paralegals (provided students choose specific module options), which means they graduate with a GradNALP in addition to their LLB enjoying Paralegal status.

As part of this degree, students will have the option to get involved with practical justice including opportunities to shadow a local judge and experience live mediations from the in-house Medication Clinic. Through strong links with the local community, Citizens Advice, and local courts, students will have the opportunity to act as a Community Legal Companion for unrepresented parties at court. This is an excellent opportunity for students to gain hands-on work experience in a legal setting.

In addition to all the LLB degrees being Qualifying Law Degrees, students have designed the degrees in consultation with external stakeholders, such as local law practitioners as well as a range of local organisations. This ensures the University help students to develop the skills which are highly valued by employers, with examples including written and verbal communication, initiative, time management, flexibility and teamwork. Many graduates use these skills to become a barrister or solicitor, but others establish careers in education, public services, HRM, management, as paralegals, chartered secretaries or in financial services. This qualification can also be used to progress on to postgraduate study in law, such as an LLM, or in related areas such as management, marketing and accountancy.
courses.6f83:
Study Law with Criminology and join a challenging, vibrant and friendly community, led by an experienced team of academics, practitioners, solicitors, barristers and international lawyers.

This degree will enable students to progress to the vocational stage of lawyer’s training, to qualify as either a solicitor or barrister. This original and innovative course has been designed in consultation with senior managers to give students both a theoretical and practical experience.

As part of the degree, students will have the option to get involved with practical justice including opportunities to shadow a local judge and experience live mediations from the in-house Medication Clinic. Through the strong links with the local community, Citizens Advice, and local courts, students will have the opportunity to act as a Community Legal Companion for unrepresented parties at court. This is an excellent opportunity for students to gain hands-on work experience in a legal setting.

The course combines the traditional study of law with a progressive approach, meaning students will experience formal directed teaching in the form of lectures, seminars and tutorials, with indirect learning and teaching methods including discussions, student-led seminars, peer-assisted learning, individual and group role play and mooting.
courses.6f89:
The legal profession is well respected and a career in this field is considered by many to be highly prestigious. It therefore requires professionals with excellent academic ability and a strong work ethic. By studying Law with Politics, students can gain a sound understanding of law while studying aspects of politics that will enable them to progress to lawyers training or a career in the field of politics.

Students will be challenged to develop both academically and professionally through a combination of theoretical learning and practical skills development. Students will learn in a supportive, collaborative and friendly community environment.

During the course, students will develop a critical understanding of the main principles, themes and methods of law so that they:

  • Become a conscious legal professional.
  • Acquire and apply their critical mind to the evaluation and appreciation of contemporary socio-legal issues.
  • Experience practical learning as part of the legal education experience.

Throughout the course, students will develop transferable skills that will be essential as they embark on a professional career. Students will build their confidence and abilities in communication, research, evaluation, critical judgement, time management, team working, and meeting tight deadlines. The University will also support students with specialist training in areas such as writing and advocacy skills, and faculty will help to prepare students for the next steps in their career, for example by doing one-to-one mock interview sessions.
courses.6f6r:
The Accounting and Finance course is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge they will need to pursue a career in the fields of finance or accountancy.

Students will benefit from Christ Church Business School’s extensive links with industry. Guest speakers are regularly invited to share their knowledge with the students and students will have excellent opportunities to undertake work placements, supported by a dedicated placement officer.

The University recognise the importance of professional body accreditation and the course is structured to allow students to gain exemptions from major accounting bodies.

The experienced team has created an engaging course which captures the diversity of the national and global dimensions of finance and accounting, so students will be prepared for all kinds of roles in industry, practice, the service sector or self-employment.

Students can test their skills in a real business environment in the Bloomberg Trading Room, which recreates the high-energy City of London trading environment. This will give students the opportunity to learn the language of finance, discover the inner workings of the markets, and stand out to recruiters with "Bloomberg Certification" Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) on their CV. Students will have the opportunity to apply for exemptions from major accounting bodies, such as ACCA, ICAEW, CIMA, & IFA, and students will develop specialist accounting knowledge, critical analysis and interpersonal skills during lectures, seminars, workshops and through a variety of assessments.
courses.6f6s:
BSc Accounting and Finance degree gives students a solid grounding in the challenges of managing organisations, information technology and analytical skills alongside finance and accounting fundamentals.

The foundation year will help students to broaden their industry knowledge and enable them to progress to a related undergraduate degree. It aims to help students develop a strong foundation of business knowledge, alongside academic and transferable skills to ensure they get the most out of their degree-level studies.

Students will benefit from Christ Church Business School’s extensive links with industry. The experienced team has created an engaging course which captures the diversity of the national and global dimensions of finance and accounting, so students will be prepared for all kinds of roles in industry, practice, the service sector or self-employment.

Students will gain experience in applying their knowledge to help solve real-world problems and will develop the skills needed for further academic study and independent learning.

Students can test their skills in a real business environment in the Bloomberg Trading Room, which recreates the high-energy City of London trading environment. This will give students the opportunity learn the language of finance, discover the inner workings of the markets, and stand out to recruiters with "Bloomberg Certification" Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) on their CV.
courses.6f70:
Business management is vital in every industry. Those who're keen to develop their critical thinking skills and understand the essential areas of business, then this course covers what they need to know to become a successful business graduate.

Gaining a solid understanding of business management will readily prepare students for a career in a range of sectors and industries, including the finance and technology industries. Not only will students study the fundamental areas of business, finance, HR, marketing and operations, they will also focus on the micro and macro environments in which businesses operate. This will develop their understanding of business structures, whilst expanding their confidence and knowledge with how to handle real-world scenarios.

With such a diverse and professionally-sound curriculum, this course is industry-led, giving students the opportunity to examine and analyse real-life organisational issues within local, regional and national organisations.
courses.6f7z:
Good business management is at the centre of every successful organisation. This Business Management with Foundation Year degree enables students to build their knowledge and understanding of organisations and how they are managed. The foundation year helps students develop the study skills and self-confidence needed for higher education.

Students will study fundamental areas of business, finance, HR, marketing and operations, and the macro and micro environments in which they operate including cultural, social and ethical issues.

Students will have opportunities to examine real-life organisational problems by making the most of the strong links between Christ Church Business School and a wide range of local, regional and national organisations.

The course will introduce students to different organisations and external environments, so they can understand how they operate and are managed as businesses. It is practical in nature, which allows students to begin building their knowledge from day one.

During the foundation year, students will learn about key areas of business and will develop the skills needed to study at degree level. Throughout the degree, students will develop their business and management skills while being exposed to scenarios and real-world problems that will make them think outside the box.
courses.6cnp:
The BA (Hons) Accounting degree course at Cardiff Met is professionally accredited by the by the Association of Certified Chartered Accountants, Chartered Institute of Management Accountants and the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales. As such, students may obtain the maximum number of exemptions from these bodies’ professional examinations.

The course will provide students with a comprehensive introduction to all areas of accounting and prepares them for further study at the final stages of professional accounting qualifications.

Students selecting the sandwich option undertake a yearlong work placement between their second and third years of study. In addition, Cardiff Met has an ongoing strategic partnership with Graham Paul Chartered Accountants, which provides paid 12-week summer placements for a number of Cardiff Met students, with a view to offering permanent graduate training contracts.
courses.6cnq:
​The BA (Hons) Accounting and Economics degree at Cardiff Met has a strong emphasis on application and critical understanding. The course is professionally accredited by the Association of Certified Chartered Accountants, Chartered Institute of Management Accountants and the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales, so that students may obtain a number of exemptions from these bodies’ professional examinations and was also the first new university to adopt the new CORE curriculum in Economics.

Students selecting the sandwich option undertake a yearlong work placement between their second and third years of study. In addition, Cardiff Met has an ongoing strategic partnership with Graham Paul Chartered Accountants, which provides paid 12-week summer placements for a number of Cardiff Met students, with a view to offering permanent graduate training contracts.

Economics tutors work with organisations such as the Government Economic Service to ensure the curriculum is cutting edge and relevant.

Architectural engineers plan, design, build and maintain the buildings that shape our day-to-day existence with a focus on structural engineering, architectural design and building services.

This accredited course provides the knowledge, skills and hands-on experience. Students will need to become a work-ready architectural engineer. Through laboratory sessions, field trips, individual projects and design classes, they will embed the knowledge gained from there lectures and tutorials and develop their practical abilities in surveying and design.

Students will choose from a range of authentic, real-world engineering problems and industry-focused scenarios, to work on both individually and with student engineers from other disciplines. Group work mirrors the relationships of an engineering team and will help them to build skills in teamwork, project management and communication. Open access makerspace provides a place for them to design, create and collaborate.
courses.6bv0:
The Flagship LLB Law program is a full time, three-year course that is both challenging and stimulating.

Study foundation modules (which constitute the academic stage of training that is currently necessary to become a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales) together with a wide selection of exciting, optional modules that include Environmental Law, Human Rights Law, Media Law and Family Law.

In addition to the broad-based academic training we provide, studying Law at Cardiff will offer students an unique opportunities to see Law in action in a social context.

We are committed to providing an outstanding teaching and learning experience that is underpinned by excellent research activity.

We are the only Russell Group University to offer both courses currently required to qualify as a barrister or solicitor – the Bar Professional Training Course and the Legal Practice Course – which means that they have the option to stay with us in Cardiff to complete their entire legal education.
courses.6by1:
BSc Business Management (International Management) is designed to equip them with practical skills and professional confidence for a successful career in a multinational corporation.

Students will develop international management expertise from the team of researchers and business practitioners. They’ll introduce them to the principles of multiculturalism, ethics and morality and practices like cultural marketing, international business logistics and human resource management.

Their Professional Placement Year is an opportunity to put their university knowhow into practice as they take up a paid role and complement their academic study with exposure to real-world international business scenarios.
courses.6byp:
BSc Accounting and Finance with a Professional Placement Year program is accredited by the Accounting Professional Bodies and is designed to equip them with practical skills and professional confidence for a successful career in accounting and finance-related roles, or in preparation for postgraduate study and research.

On a universal first year, shared with their BSc Accounting program they will develop business and finance expertise from the team of international researchers and qualified accounting professionals. They will be introduced to corporate finance and strategy, markets, institutions and taxation while being encouraged to consider the social, economic and ethical implications of their decisions.

Their Professional Placement Year is an opportunity to put their university knowhow into practice as they take up a paid accounting or finance role and complement their academic study with exposure to real-world business scenarios.
courses.6bxx:
BSc Business Management focuses on organizations of all kinds from multinational corporations to social enterprises and charities. This holistic approach ensures them to develop the skills to respond to the evolving needs of all businesses, irrespective of sector.

Students will develop management expertise from the team of international researchers and business practitioners. They’ll introduce them to disciplines like accounting, digital technology, marketing, human resources and employment, management, and economics.

With their support, students will build a skill set to respond to current developments and challenges in business and society, while preparing to launch a successful career or pursue further postgraduate study and research.
courses.6by2:
BSc Business Management (Logistics and Operations) focuses on organizations of all kinds from multinational corporations to social enterprises and charities. This holistic approach ensures them to develop the skills to respond to the evolving needs of all businesses, irrespective of sector.

They will develop logistics and operations management expertise from the team of internationally renowned researchers. They’ll introduce them to the practices of purchasing and supply, logistics and distribution and advanced operations management.

With their support, students will build a skill set to respond to current developments and challenges in business and society, while preparing to launch a successful career in the logistics industry or pursue further postgraduate study and research.
courses.6bw9:
Brexit and the Bedroom Tax to wages and wealth, environment and energy to health and homelessness, economists have rarely held such influence in the direction and debate of issues affecting the communities of the world.

It’s no wonder then, that employers are offering high wage graduate careers across the public sector, business, banking, accountancy and consultancy for those with economic expertise.

BSc Econ Economics seeks to discover a new generation of economic thinkers.

Research-led faculty will encourage them to consider the social, economic and ethical implications of their decisions on modules in labor economics, development, ethics and morality.

With their support, students will turn theory into practice and seek answers to a range of social and political issues, in preparation for careers in business, banking and consultancy roles or postgraduate and doctoral study.
courses.1il0:
Program Description

The future of marketing: this course is for those who love social media, influencers, brands and getting your message out to your audience. Digital media and communications, particularly social media, have transformed marketing and advertising, creating exciting careers for creative and talented graduates.

Our course focuses on the development of practical digital marketing skills to give you a real insight to the dynamic world of 21st century business. You’ll apply your knowledge in our state-of-the-art digital marketing lab and analyse real-life business case studies, developing your own expertise and innovation to connect customers, products, services and brands.

You’ll gain a Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) accredited degree, the opportunity to complete the CIM Diploma in Professional Marketing, hear from industry guest speakers and the chance to apply for a company internship with past students working for well-known companies like Microsoft, Procter and Gamble, L’Oreal, Disney and Rolls Royce.
courses.1igr:
Program Description

We cover the most broad spectrum of transport design examining issues of autonomy, sustainability, ergonomics and the user experience in relation to exterior and interior design, surface and colour applications, lifestyle and future design solutions.

An award-winning course with a long history of achievement, we can offer you access to state-of-the-art facilities, including wind tunnel, robotic milling, laser cutting, rapid prototyping, 3D printing and excellent clay modelling facilities.

courses.1in2:
Managing businesses and people requires serious and honed leadership skills. Studying Business Management is one of the best ways to prepare!

This versatile degree, which currently benefits from EPAS accreditation from the European Foundation for Management Development (EFMD), will provide students with an opportunity to gain a solid grounding in business management theory, skills, tools and techniques – from economics and accounting to organisational behaviour, marketing and business analytics. With its distinctive focus on corporate engagement, responsible management and internationalisation, the course offers students the option to select two modules from across three focus areas, supply chain management focus, leadership focus, and global focus, all of which are designed to help students further their development in a specific area of interest.

Coventry has excellent links with a range of national and international employers. The department's teaching is grounded in the corporate world, by using real-life international case studies, providing a range of exciting work placement options (which may be subject to availability, a competitive application process, additional costs and/or meeting applicable visa requirements, and allowing students the opportunity to study in our Business Simulation Suite.
courses.1ikw:
Program Description

All forms of business require a HRM professional. This human resources degree can teach you about managing and treating employees fairly. Relying on Human Resource Management (HRM) and Development (HRD) professionals, successful organisations recognise the importance of being able to recruit, select, develop, motivate, performance manage and reward their employees efficiently and effectively in order to realise their business goals.

Coventry University has delivered HRM courses for over 30 years. This course is designed to develop a sound understanding of the knowledge, skills and behaviours required by HRM professionals today and support individuals looking to develop a career in managing and leading people.

In addition to your degree, you can achieve the Chartered Institute of Personnel Development (CIPD) Intermediate Certificate or Diploma in either HRM or HRD. You will have to pass certain CIPD Modules to gain credits to obtain the certificate or diploma.

Within the fiercely competitive and global economy, marketing is now central to commercial success. Businesses and organisations across every sector – private, public and non-profit – need to determine and differentiate their brand, communicating effectively who they are and what they do to past, present and potential customers.

This professionally accredited course is designed to help students gain the confidence and business acumen  necessary to develop, position and build businesses in the most strategically effective way. The university aims to provide a solid understanding of business analysis, planning, and management, alongside specialist marketing skills, such as understanding customer behaviour, developing creative solutions and how to promote competitive advantage.

Coventry's status as a Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) accredited Study Centre means this degree provides exemption from the CIM Certificate in Professional Marketing, as well as the first module of the CIM Diploma in Professional Marketing via the Graduate Gateway scheme.

Program Description

A Childhood, Youth and Education Studies degree may open the door to a range of rewarding areas of practice working with children and young people. If you are passionate about achieving the best outcomes for children and young people and you want to learn alongside like-minded people in an innovative learning environment, then the Childhood, Youth and Education Studies degree aims to both excite and challenge you. Our course offers you a flexible learning experience where you will have the opportunity to tailor your learning to develop the knowledge, skills and experience needed to pursue the particular area of work with children and young people you are most passionate about.

Investing in the education of children and young people is essential for the growth of individuals and communities that flourish. The Childhood, Youth and Education Studies degree is designed for people who want to contribute to the learning and development of children and young people in a variety of educational settings. While on the course you will have the opportunity to explore important areas of educational practice, formal and informal, through both in-class learning and practical work experience. You can learn from academics and practice partners who currently collectively have experience across a range of relevant areas of study and practice. Over the course of your studies you will also have the opportunity to take part in a range of exciting international and UK based educational experiences. You can find out more about the international opportunities on offer on Coventry University’s Centre for Global Engagement web pages.
