Program Description

This Middlesex University course gives students the tools to succeed in this dynamic and rewarding profession.

Accountancy is at the core of every business which means that the BA Accounting and Finance course offers students a range of opportunities in every industry, from banking to fashion and everywhere in between. Students will develop their advanced theoretical knowledge as well as a practical understanding of all things finance. Covering key areas within financial and management accounting, taxation and business law, they’ll gain a deep understanding of the role accounting plays in successful organisations.

During their studies, students will have the opportunity to do a paid work placement, either as a year-long project or two shorter placements. Here students will get the chance to test and improve their technical skills in the real world, as well as building their soft employability skills such as communication and team work.
courses.1iv4:
Program Description

This versatile business management BA degree gives students the space to develop their management skills. Whatever their goals are, students can build their business expertise before beginning a fulfilling career.

During the course, students will build the professional skill set needed to deal with the challenges they'll face in the fast-paced corporate world, from financial skills enabling them to make monetary decisions to supply management skills allowing them to keep a business operating. Developing their theory in the lecture halls, students will study the operations of organizations, strategy, design & production, resource acquisition, business processes and more.

Once they’ve built up that foundation of knowledge, students will have the opportunity to undertake a paid work placement, where students will put the theory they’ve learned into practice, developing their working knowledge of business and figuring out what they would like to specialise in.
courses.1iv8:
Understanding contemporary corporate finance is the key to understanding modern business. Covering all areas of finance including investment analysis and capital management, students will have the tools to solve financial problems faced by business today.

This course is tailored towards ambitious students who want a management and finance degree, and they will learn in a live environment. Using data from the London Stock Exchange, students will form portfolios of listed companies and compare it against the market. They’ll identify over and under-priced companies, as well as calculating Beta, among other skills.

Students will take on the challenge of a work placement, developing their theory and practical skills to an employable level, as well as developing their understanding of financial organisations.

During this BA in Business Management (Finance), students will develop key business skills to help them in a management or financial career. Focusing on topics such as resource management, leadership, business finance and analysis, students will have the ability to work effectively as part of a team. Presenting and communicating their ideas will give them confidence in a fast paced business environment, and they'll have specialist knowledge in business strategy and process.

Through this course students can become a student member of the Chartered Management Institute, leading to full membership upon graduation. They’ll also successfully train to get Bloomberg and DataStream certificates during their degree, a key part of the course.
courses.1iw4:
International business degrees are in high demand in the global world. With this Middlesex University course, students will develop a range of transferable skills which are essential in business settings. These include communication, information technology, critical thinking, and teamwork.

Students will gain these skills alongside a deep theoretical foundation that’ll cover marketing, human resource management, global strategy, intercultural ethics, and many more. Expert tutors, with years of international business experience will prepare students for an exciting career in the global marketplace.

During their studies, students will have an opportunity to do a year of study abroad, linked with partner universities in Europe and the USA. This will deepen their understanding of what international business is and help them to apply their skills and knowledge in an international setting.

Middlesex University's modules are specifically designed to give all the tools students will need to succeed in an international business career. Many of the modules are work placement based to help integrate their knowledge with work from the very start, without having to extend their studies by a year. During these modules, students will create and develop a personal development portfolio which will include their CV and covering letter, applications, and records of how students secured their work experience. They’ll get a chance to review their skills critically, identifying areas of success and improvement.
courses.1iwu:
Program Description

Middlesex University is internationally known for their law expertise – and the LLB Law puts students at the heart of legal innovation. This law course gives students the initial skills and qualifications to succeed in the legal profession and pursue qualified solicitor or barrister status in England and Wales. Recognized by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board, this course gives students the intellectual knowledge and transferable skills to innovate, reform and thrive in the legal profession.

Students will explore the wide range of legal concepts, values, principles and rules as they gain an expert knowledge of the core principles of the law in England and Wales. They’ll also put theory into practice with work-based modules that will develop their professional skills. This Middlesex University course ensures students practice their skills as they study. Middlesex places students with professional legal bodies and practitioners, giving them the opportunity to get work experience alongside their theoretical studies.
courses.1iz1:
Program Description

Middlesex University's LLB Law with Criminology lets students study two complementary perspectives while they gain the initial academic skills to become a qualified solicitor or barrister in England and Wales. They are internationally known for both their law and criminology expertise – and this law with criminology course puts students at the heart of legal innovation. Recognised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board, this Middlesex course gives students the intellectual knowledge and transferable skills that make up the first stage of professional legal education.

Students will learn the core principles of law in England and Wales while they develop their understanding of criminology – and the complexities this presents. Students will also put theory into practice with work-based modules that will help them develop the hands-on skills and expertise to compete in both the criminal justice system and the legal profession.

With this course, students will practice their skills as they study. Work placements are integral to the programme – Middlesex places their students with professional legal bodies, so they get work experience alongside their theoretical studies.
courses.1iz3:
Program Description

During this course students will learn about the challenges and opportunities within international relations while gaining the initial qualifications to pursue qualified solicitor or barrister status in England and Wales. Middlesex University has an international reputation for their law expertise – and the law with international relations course gives students the skills and support to thrive. Recognised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board as the first stage of professional training, this course equips students with the intellectual knowledge and experience that make up the first stage of professional legal training.

Students will learn the core principles of law in England and Wales while they develop their knowledge of international relations. They'll also put theory into practice with work-based modules that will help students develop the hands-on skills and expertise to succeed in the legal profession – both in the UK and internationally.

Work placements play a vital role in this course. Middlesex has an excellent network of relationships with high-profile international organizations and they'll get the opportunity to gain work experience with them as part of the course.
courses.8csj:
Why Study Artificial Intelligence and Data Science BSc Honours at Middlesex?

The Artificial Intelligence and Data Science BSc Honours at Middlesex University provides students with real-world skills and practical experience from day one. Students learn how AI and Data Science systems function, master the latest AI technologies from leading experts, and develop the skills and experience required for immediate entry into the job market or further academic study. With global demand for professionals in this field on the rise, the course equips graduates with everything needed to succeed in this exciting, high-demand sector.

Develop Critical Skills in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

Students gain a solid understanding of AI principles, implementation techniques, and approaches to solving Data Science problems using Python and other programming languages. The curriculum includes a wide range of machine learning algorithms such as neural networks, support vector machines, genetic algorithms, and generative AI. Learners also engage with cutting-edge technologies, including large language models, ontology management systems, and distributed processing tools, applying them to real-world problems in computer vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP).

Collaborate with Experts and Use Cutting-Edge Facilities

Courses are taught by experts working at the forefront of AI and data science. Students have opportunities to lead teams, collaborate on innovative, real-world projects, and develop crucial computational, entrepreneurial, and communication skills for their future careers. Learning takes place in state-of-the-art laboratories equipped with the latest industry-standard technologies.

Apply Learning in the Workplace and Prepare for a Dynamic Career

The programme includes the option for a work placement, allowing students to apply their learning in professional environments, gain valuable industry experience, and build a strong professional network before graduation. Upon completion of the course, graduates are prepared for careers in AI development, research, machine learning, and data analysis across a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, and finance.

Middlesex University’s employability service, MDXworks, supports students in finding placements and career opportunities, helping them strengthen their applications and providing the tools needed for career success.

Graduates leave the programme with a deep understanding of AI and data science theory, as well as practical experience that prepares them for employment or further study. The course provides a strong foundation and comprehensive support, ensuring graduates enter this high-growth, transformative sector with a competitive edge.
courses.731r:
The BSc (Hons) Business examines all aspects of business: management approaches, business structures, marketing, supply chains and operations management, and finance. Courses use case studies and examples drawn from a wide range of business types (from entrepreneurs to global corporations), to understand the varying ways businesses can operate and be managed.

The curriculum includes courses in marketing, management, operations, finance, supply chain, innovation, fintech, statistics, global responsibility and sustainability.

This degree programme combines a rigorous business syllabus with a personalised elective pathway. Students can choose to deepen their focus on business through their elective courses, or they can further contextualise and broaden their studies with courses that match other interests and goals.

What makes this course different:

  • Rigorous, in-depth core subject study
  • Interdisciplinary degrees, built around real-world problems
  • Flexibility to create your own academic pathway with elective courses
  • Gain core competencies and develop practical and transferable skills for your future career
  • Embedded experiential opportunities to drive real-world change
  • Explore the big issues that need agile thinking crossing subject boundaries
courses.7h7f:
The BSc (Hons) Computing with AI Technology will provide you with a recognised undergraduate qualification which combines a wide range of computing subject areas with Artificial Intelligence Technology.

It is also attractive to learners who have related IT work experience but do not hold a first degree as they provide an opportunity to achieve an academic qualification in a subject area in which they are familiar. Indeed, there is a need in the market for those with such qualifications and the programme can prepare you for a range of careers in artificial intelligence, including machine learning on cloud and programming for AI applications.
courses.7h7h:
Data Scientists carry out applied research to create innovative data driven solutions to business problems. Usually, they work with large, complex, varied, and unstructured data sets, that are not suitable for using traditional data analysis approaches and techniques. Indeed, the demand for data scientists is ever rising and a report suggest that the shortage of data scientists has become a serious constraint (Society, 2019).

According to UK National Data Strategy (Department for Digital, 2020) there is a need in the market for those with qualifications and skills in Data Science technology. This BSc programme can prepare student for a range of careers in Big Data and Data Science including technical, management, and leadership opportunities in this discipline.
courses.7h7i: This Bachelor of Science programme can prepare you for a range of careers in Innovation Technology Design, Business Intelligence and Software Development, including technical, management, and leadership opportunities in in this discipline.

Program Description

Prescribed by the Architects Registration Board (ARB) and validated by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA), this creative, project-driven course is designed to help students develop their own design approach and style.

Students will be exposed to diverse aspects of architectural design, linking sustainability and urban design with business practice. This course will equip students with skills and knowledge to tackle contemporary issues related to the built environment, exploring the design, human, professional and technical influences needed to pursue a successful career in architecture.

Reflecting modern architectural practice, Nottingham Trent University's studio culture encourages students to work collaboratively, share experiences and experiment with ideas. Students will learn the art of creative communication through drawing, model-making and 3D visualisation in Nottingham Trent University's industry-standard design studios and materials workshops.

Successful completion of this course is the first step to becoming a qualified architect, satisfying the educational requirements needed for the RIBA Part 1 qualification.
courses.1ovn:
Program Description

Developed with companies and reflecting the changing corporate world, this highly relevant course covers a broad range of management functions, processes and techniques associated with running a business. It is the ideal choice for students who want to keep their options open and shape their career aspirations during their studies.

This course will equip students with an understanding of business theory and practice in today’s domestic and international business environments. It follows a broad curriculum and covers key disciplines at all three levels.

During their studies, students will learn about the key facilities within business such as operations, marketing, accounting and finance to provide them with a comprehensive overview of how each of these functions impact real-world businesses across the globe.

This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) providing students with a dual-award status.

This course can be studied over three years full-time or four years with a placement, and offers all students the opportunity to gain some industry experience or travel overseas to study abroad in one of Nottingham Trent University's partner universities with unique opportunities scheme.

This course is designed to provide the student with a broad range of knowledge, understanding and skills relevant to business and management that will enable them to excel in a wide range of jobs once they graduate.

The accelerated nature of the course means that within three years they both complete three years of academic study and, through a compulsory internship, achieve a year of work experience.

This course allows them to learn more about the broad area of business and management and the specialist occupations such as marketing, operations management, human resource management and finance and so is readily adaptable and flexible to a wide range of business and management orientations.

Their first year of study will incorporate traditional modes of learning such as lectures and seminars, alongside business simulations, enterprise and project work, company projects and development plans and reports.

During their second year the student will study their academic modules alongside working full time. They will attend study support days at NBS and will be supported face-to-face and at distance by tutors. they'll have access to resources and feedback throughout and will be further supported by an academic mentor. As they will be working in a company, the majority of their assignments will be based on their own work, learning and development and the activities and practices of there placement company.
courses.1oun:
Program Description

The Business Management and Accounting and Finance course is designed to meet the needs of an ever-changing business world. It will provide students with a broad based understanding of business, while teaching them the importance of accounting and finance functions within an organisation.

Students will develop their analytical skills and ability to communicate ideas and financial information. By studying the role of accounting information and practices in corporate scandals that occur through time and continue to challenge modern society, students will develop core disciplines that are valued highly by employers.

All students will take part in a business simulation task, imitating the experience of running a business with a group of fellow students.

This degree also gives students accreditation towards accounting examinations from professional bodies ACCA, CIMA and ICAEW.

During the second year, students will have a variety of unique opportunities to get involved in such as studying abroad, enterprise project, internship or simply continue with their studies.

Today’s businesses are more competitive than ever and are constantly looking for new ideas to keep them ahead of their rivals. This Business Management Joint Honours degree is perfect for students to hone their business skills and have the flexibility to specialise in areas of interest.

courses.5u5w:
Dynamic, creative and hands-on, this course will equip students with the knowledge and skills to create spaces that are beautiful, functional and sustainable.

Students will explore the design and development of internal environments in relation to their overall architectural composition, considering form, structure and light. On this course, students will develop their identity as a designer and gain key transferable skills that will prepare them for a graduate career in architectural design, interior decoration and interior design.

Based in the Grade II listed Gothic Revival style Arkwright building, students will study in a studio culture that reflects modern practice, and an environment that challenges them to work collaboratively, share experiences and experiment with ideas. Students will get the opportunity to work on live design projects, with creative briefs from real clients, and engage with guest lectures from industry experts.

Bringing together the ability to design creative and practical spaces, a sound knowledge of the theory and principles that underpin the construction of space, and advanced communication methods, this course is designed to help students develop the key skills needed for a career in interior architectural design.

Please be advised that this course has a sandwich year.
courses.1ow4:
Program Description

Digital technology has revolutionised the way people consume information, and journalists play a vital role in gathering information and reporting on unfolding world events, current affairs, politics, sport and entertainment across multiple platforms, to meet people's increasingly voracious appetite for real-time news.

Nottingham Trent University's BA (Hons) in Journalism has been developed in close association with major media organisations to provide an industry-recognised qualification that is highly valued by employers. The course is accredited by the National Council for the Training of Journalists (NCTJ) and, while on the course students will sit NCTJ exams, leading to the NCTJ Diploma. All fees for these exams are included in the course costs.

As well as the traditional skills of writing for newspapers and magazines, interviewing, media law, politics and shorthand, students will be given digital skills including writing for online, the use of social media in journalism, and creating and using video content. Students will also gain a range of transferable skills that can be used in a range of media industries from public relations to communication officers.
courses.85l3: The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Business and Management equips students with a comprehensive understanding of business operations, strategic management, marketing, and finance. Through case studies, simulations, and practical projects, students develop leadership and decision-making skills. Graduates are prepared for a wide range of roles in business development, human resources, entrepreneurship, or corporate management.
courses.85j1: The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Business and Marketing Management covers business operations with a focus on marketing strategy, brand management, digital marketing, and consumer behaviour. Students apply theory through case studies and live projects, preparing for dynamic careers in brand development, sales, market analysis, or entrepreneurship.
courses.85k9: The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in International Business Management equips students with a global perspective on business operations. This program covers key business disciplines such as finance, marketing, operations, and human resource management, with a strong emphasis on cross-cultural communication, international trade, and global strategic planning. Students gain a thorough understanding of how international markets operate and how businesses develop global strategies, making them well-suited for roles in multinational corporations, global consultancy firms, and international development agencies.
courses.85kz: The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Social Work prepares students for professional practice in supporting individuals and communities. The course includes theoretical study in human development, social policy, and ethics, alongside placements in real-world settings. Students gain the knowledge and practical experience required for registration as a social worker and a career in health and social care services.
courses.85k7: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Anthropology provides a deep exploration of human culture, biology, and evolution. Students study diverse societies, beliefs, and customs across the globe while also examining biological anthropology to understand human development. The course develops analytical, research, and intercultural communication skills, opening career opportunities in international development, heritage and museums, academic research, and community outreach programs.
courses.85k4: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Business and Finance provides an in-depth understanding of financial systems and business management. Students cover topics such as corporate finance, investment analysis, economics, accounting, and strategic decision-making. The course emphasizes real-world applications and quantitative skills, preparing graduates for careers in banking, financial analysis, corporate strategy, and financial consultancy.
courses.85m3: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Computer Science equips students with comprehensive knowledge in software development, algorithms, data structures, databases, and computer systems. The program emphasizes practical problem-solving and includes modules in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and human-computer interaction. Students develop programming proficiency, critical thinking, and project management skills through hands-on assignments and group projects. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in software engineering, systems analysis, or IT consultancy across various sectors.
courses.85l6: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Information Technology for Business integrates IT systems knowledge with strategic business applications. Students study topics such as databases, systems analysis, programming, and business processes, gaining skills to manage technology solutions in corporate environments. The program prepares graduates for roles in IT management, systems consultancy, business analysis, or project coordination.
courses.25jj:
This Ravensbourne University London course looks at the communication between movement and narrative. One of the leading animation courses in the country and the only one of its kind in London; the course will help students to apply animation skills to a broad range of careers by using a mix of practice and theory-based learning. It encourages students to respond to live and self-initiated briefs, to solve creative problems. The course involves a mix of practice and theory-based learning, including lectures, seminars, workshops, individual tutorials and self-directed study. Students will have access to industry standard software and will produce an assessed portfolio of creative and professional work.

Key study topics include: Contemporary culture, Animation fundamentals, Modelling to camera, Human and creature mechanic, Visual narrative, Animation industry, and more.

Animation is an increasingly widespread form of media and good animators are becoming more sought after in film, television, VFX, gaming and the web. Animation graduates often go on to secure work as 3D/2D generalists as well as specialists in areas including: concept, modelling, animation and VFX production. Past graduates have been employed in roles within film and television, visual effects, advertising, post-production, apps and games.
courses.25k4:
This advertising and brand design degree course will give students the skills to develop a critical and contextual understanding of advertising and brand design. Working collaboratively with others, students will learn how the industry is being transformed by emerging digital technologies and discover innovative ways to solve creative problems. Students may work with massive brands like Apple, through the course's unrivalled industry links.

Students ‘learn with industry’ engaging with professional practice throughout the course. In the last three years, Ravensbourne University London has worked with global brands like Apple, Sky, Barclays Bank and The O2 and leading studios such as Moving Brands, Studio Blup, Kin+Carta and JKR. Most recently, Ravensbourne University London was privileged to work with Apple on an exhibition called Unsigned Stories, which is featured below.

This advertising and branding degree investigates how visual stories are deployed to bring products and services to life. Students examine diverse areas of marketing, branding and advertising, including: how to develop brand communication, social media content, marketing strategy and interactive experience. Students will also learn to create graphic design communication for contemporary media platforms.

Students will construct stories that connect strategically across print, social and online channels to engage audiences and influence perception. As well as exploring cutting-edge, such as apps, digital print, online media and mobile games, students will also examine traditional communication formats, like print-based media. This degree in advertising really will provide students with a solid grounding.

Creative advertising, social media, digital technology, communication, storytelling and brand design are all prominent branches on the all-encompassing marketing tree. They are also decisive factors in what makes many contemporary companies successful and stand out from the crowd. As such, when students graduate with a BA honours degree in Advertising and Brand Design at Ravensbourne University London, they will not just be given a robust foundation to help them move into their chosen field of expertise. Students will also boost their all-round employability, developing a diverse skill-set that is highly transferable.
courses.25jm:
Through this architecture degree course, students will take inspiration from art, philosophy and technology to explore the spaces and places they inhabit. With access to gold-standard facilities and the highest-caliber teaching, students will develop their own creative vision by exploring the role architecture plays in shaping the society.

In graduating from this esteemed architecture course in London, students will possess multidisciplinary knowledge and vital transferable skills, which will prepare them for a career within the many threads of architecture. These include: urban design, housing and office design, planning, building conservation, architectural heritage and community development.
courses.90el:
Bachelor of Arts (Honours) - Business Management with Fashion is designed for those seeking careers in business, with a particular focus on fashion in a global context. The creative flair and networks that Ravensbourne University fosters enable students to collaborate with like-minded peers, business practitioners, and educators to better understand, innovate, and research in these areas.

Accordingly, the BSc (Hons) Business Management with Fashion engages students in real-world business explorations while simultaneously offering transferable skill development opportunities, emphasising those that will support their chosen career paths. This insightful degree delivers collaborative core business practice alongside refined skills in management, strategy, and research, which support and enhance students’ journeys into the ever-evolving fashion business landscape.

Embedded within the course are key themes that, from both present and future standpoints, challenge and animate creativity in business and creative enterprise. These themes — the Four Pillars of the BSc (Hons) Business Management with Fashion — are: (i) Innovation, (ii) Creative Perspectives, (iii) Ethics, Social Responsibility, and Sustainability, and (iv) Future Perspectives. Each of these pillars is integrated across all course modules.
courses.6fe8:
This practice-led course uniquely prepares students for entry into the rapidly changing field of contemporary illustration. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and strong industry links, the course will enable students to sharpen their skills and promote their craft.

Students will explore ideas and themes across commercial, social, political, and cultural contexts, utilising narratives in compelling and innovative ways.

Ravensbourne will prepare students to be experimental and creative practitioners, equipped to work across different media and formats. The course is informed by illustration’s rich heritage and yet is forward-thinking in its understanding of the application of contemporary illustration in the 21st century. It will turn illustrators into contemporary visual storytellers and help them to find their individual visual voice. Students will explore and apply their skills across a range of illustrative applications including: editorial, publishing, packaging, product, print, advertising, character and film.

This course crosses many creative boundaries with opportunities within multiple sectors including graphic design, advertising, publishing, fashion, product design, animation and games design.
courses.6fe0:
Successful content creation can be game changing for brands, enhancing their visibility and enabling them to connect with audiences worldwide. On this course in digital content creation, learn how to build long-term awareness and engagement.

Become part of Ravensbourne’s creativity community, and learn the skills required to develop film and digital content to create powerful campaigns. Support business and marketing strategies for brands and companies and build solid entrepreneurial skills.

Ravensbourne is a pioneer in the creative application of digital technologies. Students will learn the creative and conceptual skills required to produce digital content to create powerful campaigns. These can be used to support marketing strategies for brands of all sizes, as well as individuals who want to communicate their ideas to the public. By the end of the course, students will have built up an impressive portfolio of digital content creation skills and already have a wealth of experience working with clients.

The modules on this BA (Hons) Digital Content Creation course enable students to gradually build their creative, conceptual and digital content skills and enable them to enhance their long-term career or future academic choices.

Students will always be encouraged to network and make contacts for the future, and there will be opportunities to work on live briefs for clients. Students will develop their communication skills through pitches, and use industry-standard professional equipment and software to produce high-quality content.
courses.25k8:
The Digital Film Production program combines the main elements of film production, screenwriting and film theory. Students will learn how to augment stories through digital film productions, utilizing cutting-edge technologies.

Taking a holistic and practical approach, students will explore the professional aspects of filmmaking. The course is underpinned by the film industry and will give them the skills and experience to produce innovative film shorts, features, commercials and documentaries.

In this film and television production course at Ravensbourne University London, students will cover all aspects of the digital film production journey – from financial backing to building a fan base. With an emphasis on hands-on training, they will have access to high specification digital cameras, Steadicams, dolly systems and green screens to hone their technical skillset. Students will be granted access to high-end computer labs loaded with the latest digital applications for post-production editing.

Taught through a blend of practice and theory-based learning, which includes lectures, workshops, seminars and self-directed study, the BA (Hons) Digital Film Production degree is led by production and broadcast experts with excellent industry experience.

This exciting film and TV production degree is divided into two distinct pathways: film production and operations. The production strand is tailored to those who want to make innovative television programming using a variety of distribution platforms, including social media. The operations avenue will teach students about varied film production techniques and digital operations, including the use of media asset management systems.
courses.25ju:
The Digital Photography program is the destination for budding contemporary photographers who wish to push the boundaries of a powerful medium. Accredited by the Association of Photographers (AOP) and the Royal Photographic Society (RPS), students will learn to decipher creative briefs, develop their own photographic style and prepare collections for exhibitions and competitions.

This industry-focused photography degree provides an education in the broader areas of digital photographic practice and will instill an understanding of the rapidly changing principles and methods that underpin new and emerging creative commercial practice.

Students will use practical skills, knowledge and critical application of digital photography, helping them to explore the creative potential of their camera. Through a mix of practice and theory-based learning, they will be taught to think like a photographer and explore how images are created, shared, distributed and sold.

The program is designed to combine practical skills with a knowledge of the critical application of digital photography. Students will explore the creative potential of the camera and the theories and movements that drive change.

Students will be encouraged to develop their own distinctive portfolio to showcase a high level of technical skill, whilst understanding the theory of photography, as well as seek opportunities for placements at top London agencies and photographers. They will also be encouraged to work collaboratively with other students across the college and different disciplines.
courses.7ak0:
The BSc (Hons) Business Management offers students the opportunity to develop a career with global possibilities. BSc (Hons) Business Management Degree exposes students to key concepts in areas such as people management, business law, marketing, strategic management, information systems and big data, project management, finance and innovation and enterprise. This undergraduate course will equip students to enter a range of business roles in the public and private sectors.

In addition to nurturing academic and sector specific knowledge, the programme aims to support students' development of key employability skills, such as critical thinking, problem solving and data analysis. This BSc (Hons) Business Management course is designed to provide a broad understanding of business functions within the business and commercial world. Students will also have the opportunity to transfer to individual pathways in specific areas of business if they wish. The 3 year course offers students a route into general management as well as specialist areas, such as business accounting and finance, enterprise, human resource management, business law, marketing, retail or supply chain management. Overall, this type of Bachelor’s degree aims to give students an essential appreciation of the skills needed to thrive and adapt in the changing world of work.
courses.7ak7:
This three-year BSc (Hons) Computer Science program will support students in gaining all the practical and problem-solving skills they will need to excel in this constantly evolving and highly rewarding field.

This course is designed to develop an in-depth understanding of the theory, design and implementation of algorithms for manipulating data and information. Students would gain a broad education in computer science, with a focus on problem-solving, developing solutions using software and managing the process of innovation.

Throughout the course, the student will apply appropriate theory, tools and methodologies to develop effective solutions, while building the skills needed to adapt and learn new technologies as the computer industry evolves.

By the end of the course, students will be well prepared for success in employment or further study.

Distinctive Features of the Program :

  • The Computing program has been designed collaboratively working with industrial partners to ensure that students study a comprehensive program of relevant industrial topics.
  • A flexible program of study with the ability to specialize in specific career-oriented pathways in the second half of the program.
  • The success of the graduates is directly related to the practical aspects covered in the course laboratory work.
courses.7ake:
The three-year BSc (Hons) Health and Social Care degree is designed to prepare students to make a positive impact on the daily lives of vulnerable people.

Delivered in excellent teaching facilities, the undergraduate programme provides opportunities for students to develop the values, practical skills and knowledge required for a successful career in the global health and social care sector.

Led by a highly experienced and dedicated teaching team, the programme explores key principles including professional values, ethical care practices, the promotion of physical and mental health, safeguarding, and the advocacy of diversity and inclusion. Its focus is on developing knowledgeable, compassionate and person-centred care professionals.

The BSc (Hons) Health and Social Care provides a strong academic pathway for students preparing to enter the health and social care workplace or progress to further study in a related academic or professional area.

The second year includes a placement module, giving students the opportunity to gain practical experience in a health and social care setting. The module focuses on the development of generic competencies, while enabling students to gain an understanding of workplace functions and structures. During the placement, students are required to maintain a written reflective log and are supported by a tutor who helps them demonstrate the learning gained through their practical experience.

The placement module is linked to an employability module, which focuses on transferable skills and career planning. This enables students to consider their personal and professional development throughout the programme and to prepare for future employment opportunities.

In the final year, students can expand their knowledge in specific areas of health and social care that are of particular interest to them. Available modules include children and families, mental health and safeguarding. These options provide insight into potential areas of specialisation and support the development of deeper knowledge and understanding.

The programme also includes a module examining vulnerability in relation to people who use health and social care services. Compassionate, person-centred care is considered throughout the degree, alongside the principles and practices required to support individuals effectively.

Students will also study research methods and approaches in health and social care. This includes the development of a research proposal, which will provide the foundation for the final research project or dissertation. This work enables students to develop knowledge and understanding in an area of personal interest, while preparing them for postgraduate study and demonstrating academic skills that can be applied in the workplace.

Learning through case studies, workshops and role play is embedded throughout the programme. These activities enable students to explore how theoretical and academic learning connects with practice in the health and social care sector.
courses.63z5:
Many businesses rely on enterprise and innovation to manage uncertainty and ensure sustained growth. This course teaches students to become an effective entrepreneur and an innovative leader – with the insight to identify opportunities, implement new processes, harness new technology and transform global businesses into market leaders.

Students will discover how to identify and develop a potential market opportunity, and drive sustained business growth – undertaking market research, making strategic decisions, managing uncertainty, exploring new technology, generating ideas and overcoming challenges.

Working with classmates, students will construct a business plan for a new profitable offering and work together to refine it – for instance, analysing the cost implications of adding or subtracting certain features. By doing this, students will gain a solid grounding in business principles and a deep understanding of how enterprises thrive: learning core competencies like finance, law, regulations, operations and organisational behaviour, while developing specialist skills, creative thinking, strategic decision-making and ability to innovate, globally.

From global organisations to new start-ups, studying in London offers opportunities to engage with all aspects of the business arena – gaining valuable work experience and meeting influential industry contacts.

Students will join bootcamps, simulations and creative labs to learn to think like a leader and an entrepreneur, and work on live briefs commissioned by industry experts that will expose them to real-world business issues and give them the strategic skills to combat them.

Students will graduate with a practical, future-facing business education that's entrepreneurial, network-driven and tech engaged.

The Foundation year is structured around an entrepreneurial challenge, with modules that introduce the transferable skills they will need at degree level and beyond.

Once students have successfully completed the foundation year, they will progress to the first year of BA (Hons) Global Management (Finance).

Students will gain a solid grounding in management principles, together with a broad set of business skills. Building upon this foundation, they will develop specialist knowledge in your chosen pathway.

The Finance Pathway

The Finance pathway offers a holistic approach to financial management and fintech. Students will explore the inner workings of financial corporations and consider the influence and impact of emerging technologies.

A global perspective is a core aspect. Learning about other cultures and interacting with students from all over the world will prepare them to work in the global business arena. Students will also have the opportunity to learn a new language.

The Foundation year is structured around an entrepreneurial challenge, with modules that introduce the transferable skills students will need at degree level and beyond.

Once students have successfully completed their foundation year, they will progress to the first year of BA (Hons) Business and Marketing.

Students will gain a solid grounding in management principles, together with a broad set of business skills. Building upon this foundation, students will develop specialist knowledge in their chosen course.

This course focuses on marketing theory and practice – helping students to grow into a media-savvy marketer with the confidence to respond to rapid market changes, develop integrated strategies, build creative campaigns and convert targets into leads while managing teams across the globe.

Students will examine current debates, such as the extent to which big data will replace traditional data collection methods and start to think from a marketing communications (marcomms) perspective – developing new campaign objectives and crafting effective messages, supported by independent research and competitor analysis.

Practical, experience-based simulations and challenges with industry experts will expose students to real-world business issues and prepare them with the hands-on experience needed to develop and launch a luxury enterprise.

Students will have the option to undertake an independent placement or enterprise project to gain further industry experience, or they can study abroad for a term at one of Regent’s University London's international partners to broaden their understanding of management and enterprise in a global context. Students will also have the opportunity to learn a new language – preparing them to work in an international arena.
courses.7xkh:
Program Description

Bachelor of Arts (Honours) - Business and Data Science with Integrated foundation helps students to get an interdisciplinary education, designed to equip you with the knowledge and skills to apply current and emerging data science techniques in a business context. The course places students at the forefront of industries in which business and data science intersect. Students will gain skills that are currently in high demand—enabling you to become a successful business professional with a sound grasp on the fundamentals of data science. You will learn technical skills, apply business knowledge, gain practical experience, and cover topics like finance, organizational culture, data analytics, statistics, data visualization, and business strategy.

Students' learning will be theoretical, conceptual, and practical, and always aligned with industry, so students can gain hands-on skills for their career in data science.

This course helps students to become:

  • Proficient in the integration of business acumen and data science tools and
  • Techniques
  • A data-driven decision-maker at operational and strategic levels
  • Entrepreneurial and network-driven.
  • Globally, culturally, and ethically responsive
courses.2ao5:
Program Description

This degree with integrated foundation aims to prepare students for a professional and creative career as an interior designer.

The integrated foundation has been specially designed to give students the introductory knowledge and skills needed to confidently progress to degree-level study.

In the foundation year, students will develop a broad understanding of the creative industries, touching on aspects of fashion design, fashion marketing, illustration, interior design and graphic design.

Once students have successfully completed the foundation year, they will progress to the first year of BA (Hons) Interior Design

Regent's University London's holistic approach to interior design will enable students to develop their own design philosophy.

Students will be introduced to a broad range of design methods and principles, including digital technologies and professional standards. Approaching a range of public and private spaces, students will consider design ideas from a variety of perspectives including history, architecture, social and environment impact as well as purpose.

Model-making is a core element of this degree. Students create models of design ideas using specialist facilities and document the end product in our photography studio.

Professional practice modules will give opportunities to work on live projects with real clients. Students will be expected to consider all aspects of the design process from creative development to commercial and financial factors.

When you graduate, students will have a diverse portfolio of work that can be showcased to potential clients and employers.

This bespoke training will prepare students for a creative career across a wide range of sectors including commercial, residential, exhibition and installation and places of leisure and culture.
courses.66yb:

  • Truly international environment at Richmond and US and UK degree helps access to leading graduate schools in the UK and the USA

  • Explore the worlds of PR, advertising and communications in London, the hub of the global marketing communications industry

  • Gain an in-depth understanding of media within a broader context with our liberal arts approach which encompasses topics such as science, philosophy and international relations

Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Criminology blends the disciplines of criminology, psychology, international law, and political science and international relations with expertise in research methods, preparing students for a wide range of careers in criminal justice, police and law enforcement, border protection, security, and community safety. Other careers include employment in international organizations, business, finance, government institutions, agencies, consultancies, advocacy groups, and the media.

Students specialize in five areas in the study of Criminology and its connected fields (plus Combined Studies):

  • Core theories and practices of Criminology: theories of crime, criminality and victimhood (and critical responses to these); finding and interpreting data concerning crime; institutions of the criminal justice system (including law enforcement agencies, the judicial system, corrections and rehabilitation, and alternative approaches); types of crime; crime prevention strategies.
  • Key contemporary issues in Criminology: social structure and crime; deviant behaviour and social norms; criminology and the changing role of the media; organized crime; international criminal activities; terrorism/extremism and state responses to these; criminology in popular culture.
  • Psychology: Clinical psychology is the broad field of psychology to which forensic psychology belongs. Students study psychology throughout the programme, from Introduction to Psychology at level 4, to Human Science Research at level 5, to Clinical Psychology at level 6. This provides real substance to Criminology at Richmond as a genuinely interdisciplinary programme.
  • Public Policy: Ensuring students understand the global legal and political contexts for crime, as well as the issues and problems policy-makers and political processes face in addressing the dynamics of crime and criminal behaviour which may be transnational in character. Includes International Law and Human Rights at level 5 and Policy-Making in a Globalized World at level 6. Students engage in interdisciplinary cognate fields to Criminology (International Relations and Political Science) while addressing cutting edge issues on the discipline such as human rights violations.
  • Research Methods: Quantitative and Qualitative approaches and research ethics. There is strong emphasis on research methods in the programme. All students take probability and statistics as a core maths requirements, and study qualitative research methods both in the core Research Methods in Criminology course and as embedded in the other Criminology courses, as well as taking Human Science Research as part of the Psychology stream. Research ethics are addressed at various points in the programme, including in the Service-Learning course (Global Citizenship and Migration) and the final Senior Project in Criminology.
  • Combined Studies: students take a range of courses as part of the US ‘Liberal Arts’ component of the programme, including from arts and humanities, the sciences, and a service-learning course, as well as a further course in either International Relations or Psychology. There is also space in the degree structure for students to take a Minor in a range of other subject areas.

The BA (Hons) Marketing programme at Richmond American University London prepares students to identify market opportunities, anticipate trends, and develop digital marketing strategies that engage audiences and support business success. The programme equips students with the knowledge and skills required to influence audiences across multiple channels and make a meaningful impact in the marketplace.

In the first year, students build a strong foundation in business and marketing fundamentals while developing critical thinking skills and examining the impact of significant events such as Brexit and the Covid-19 pandemic. In subsequent years, they deepen their understanding of digital marketing by exploring customer journey stages, engagement strategies, website traffic generation, search engine optimisation, paid advertising, social media, and email marketing.

During the third and fourth years, students can tailor their studies through elective subjects such as data science, advanced computer applications in business, coding, and web design. The flexible Liberal Arts structure also allows them to select complementary and career-enhancing courses in areas including public relations, media and advertising, international business, finance, investment, accounting, economics, communication, and computer programming.

The programme develops a comprehensive understanding of business, placing marketing and digital technologies within their wider organisational context. Students learn to use digital marketing tools to design and deliver effective strategies throughout the complete campaign lifecycle.

Students examine successful global marketing practices and explore how they contribute to competitive advantage and organisational success. They also learn how to position and promote products and services, from initial concept through to launch, by analysing markets and engaging effectively with target audiences.

Contemporary debates surrounding marketing ethics are explored alongside a range of ethical approaches to digital marketing. This enables students to consider the wider social and professional responsibilities associated with marketing practice.

Practical learning opportunities include working on live marketing briefs, allowing students to apply their knowledge to genuine business challenges. Guest speakers from industry provide additional insights into the digital marketing sector and the skills required for professional success.

Studying in London provides access to a global centre for marketing, advertising, and digital communication, as well as potential internship opportunities. Following graduation, students may be eligible to apply for four exemptions from the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants and gain accreditation from the Chartered Institute of Marketing.

Program Description

By combining Classics (75% of your course) with Philosophy (25%) you'll have the opportunity to study ancient Greek and Latin as the major element of your degree alongside ancient and modern philosophy. With roots of the subject anchored in the ancient world, Philosophy makes an ideal partner for classical subjects.

Classics is perfect if you have a knowledge and love of either Latin or Greek and want to add that second ancient language to your repertoire while learning more about the classical world through the study of texts in the original as well as artefacts, ideas and past-deeds.

You will study both Latin and Greek language and literature, reading texts in the original words of the author. The remainder of your time will be spent understanding the minds, hearts and actions of the ancient Romans and Greeks through the study of ancient philosophy, history, classical archaeology as well as Latin and Greek literature in translation.

As a Classicist, you will be part of our Classics department, where the quality of research that informs our teaching and a friendly, individual approach which shapes the way we guide our students combine to create an unbeaten academic experience. A thriving Classics Society contributes to the friendly and sociable atmosphere of our department.

At Royal Holloway, we have a unique approach to Philosophy that looks beyond the narrow confines of the Anglo-American analytic or the European tradition of philosophy focus on both traditions, their relationship and connections between them. The result has been the creation of a truly interdisciplinary and collaborative course that brings together academic staff from departments across the university.

With the opportunity to examine (amongst other things) the mind and consciousness, aesthetics and morals, the self and others, the range of subjects available to Philosophy students at Royal Holloway guarantees that there will be something on offer that really engages you during your time with us.

By combining Drama (75% of your course) with Philosophy (25%) you'll have the opportunity to study Drama and Theatre as the major element of your degree alongside philosophy.

By moving between the two, you'll find your place as an informed theatre-maker, and by studying a variety of practices, by yourself and with others, you'll get knowledge of the industry as a whole, and learn how your interests could fit into the bigger picture.

Royal Holloway is top-rated for teaching and research, with a campus community recognised for its creativity. It's staff cover a huge range of theatre and performance studies, but are particularly strong in contemporary British theatre, international and intercultural performance, theatre history, dance and physical theatre, and contemporary performance practices.

Program Description

If you are fascinated by the ancient civilisations of Greece and Rome and keen to develop transferable skills such as critical analysis then this course is for you.

Taught by a variety of internationally recognised experts, Ancient History offers the opportunity to study the history of Greece and Rome in the Classical period (600 BCE to 700 CE). Over three years you will delve into the politics, events and developments underpinning our understanding of many aspects of historical societies and, indeed, our own culture. You will explore themes, key periods and problems in Greek and Roman history, such as the emergence (and fall) of democracy and the rise, decline and fall of Empires.

You will build skills and knowledge from day one. In year two, the experience of historical periods will be deepened and widened and you will develop skills in research and concentrate on your individual interests, which will culminate in specialist studies and individual research projects in year three. As you build knowledge and understanding of a formative and fascinating period of world history, you will have the opportunity to study in other areas of the curriculum, notably: archaeology, literature, philosophy and language.

As a student of Ancient History you will be part of the Classics Department, where the quality of research that informs our teaching and a friendly, individual approach which shapes the way we guide our students combine to create an unbeaten academic experience.

This LLB (Hons) degree gives you the legal tools you need for a career as a solicitor or barrister, as well as equipping you for employment in other areas if you choose not to go on to a professional qualification in law.

The programme is taught by a mix of academic experts and practitioner lawyers, who put real world clinical legal experience at the heart of the programme. You’ll develop a critical grasp of the law and its political, social and economic contexts.

This LLB is suited to students who have a general interest in law and legal studies and who do not want to focus on a particular area of law at this early stage.

This LLB programmes are flexible in structure and share a common first and second year, which gives you the option to switch to a more specialist LLB in the final year and tailor your study to a particular aspect of law. This allows you to take your time to decide on which aspect of law is right for you.

Upon successful completion of the Bradford LLB Law degree, you are able to proceed to the Legal Practice Course (for aspiring solicitors) or the Bar Professional Training Course (for aspiring barristers).

Sandwich Year

This 4-year programme offers you the opportunity to take up a placement year working in business in your third year.

Placements are real, paid jobs in a wide variety of organisations in the private, public and not-for-profit sectors and offer you a valuable opportunity to experience first-hand how business and management concepts are applied in practice, and to give you direct exposure to real issues in the workplace. It can also be done abroad.

The placement year is a vital part of your learning and will add significantly to your personal development, self-confidence, planning, communication and business acumen skills. Statistics show that students who have undertaken a placement year benefit from a better graduate job, higher graduate starting salary and a better degree outcome. In a competitive graduate market, valuable experience and employability skills gained from a year’s work placement will differentiate you from the thousands of other graduates seeking work.

Placements are not guaranteed, and students will have to invest considerable time and effort in their 2nd year in securing one, with the support of the dedicated Careers team.

Students will have access to industry-standard facilities, such as a newsroom with live news and sports feeds, as well as equipment for sound, filming, and editing.

courses.4q47:

Students will have the opportunity to participate in a placement within the local community, gaining practical skills and theoretical knowledge. Additionally, guest lecturers will provide insights on a variety of topics, enhancing the learning experience.

Students will be able to develop the knowledge and skills needed to progress to a law degrees.

As well as gaining academic knowledge of the principles of law and business, students will explore the fundamentals of applied numeracy and data handling, life skills, citizenship and how to prepare themselves for studying an honours degree at Brighton.
courses.4q22:
Program Description

The qualifying Law LLB(Hons) degree combines academic study with opportunities to experience law in practice, preparing students for a career as a legal professional.

Taken over three years, or four years with an optional salaried placement, core learning provides practical skills in presentation, negotiation, oration, mooting and advocacy, and a thorough understanding of the English legal system.

This degree is recognised by the Solicitors Regulation (SRA) Authority and the Bar Standards Board. It is a qualifying law degree, which means when students graduate they will have completed the academic stage of training for entry into the legal profession.

Extracurricular activities, such as industry-sponsored mooting and client interviewing competitions and pro bono work, allow students to further develop practical skills in problem-solving, critical analysis and communication.

Frequent, staff-led visits to London museums and galleries will also expose students to the latest developments in curating, and they will be strongly encouraged to conduct a placement in order to gain exposure to the inner workings of a museum, auction house or gallery.

To ensure students are prepared to meet the challenges facing curators in the 21st century, opportunities to cultivate digital skills will be available throughout the course. In addition, during the week students can also attend additional support classes in some modules, attend guest lectures from industry experts, take part in employability and enterprise workshops and join student societies.

Learners can opt for sandwich work placement route which can last for 9-12 months. However, they are themselves responsible for arranging their placement with support from the university. Former students of the accounting and finance course have secured placements at IBM, Northern Trust, Goldman Sachs, Lawrence Grant Solicitors and Currency Exchange Corporations Ltd.

Graduates entering the accountancy profession may go into public practice by joining an accountancy firm. Besides, it can offer students the experience of working with multiple clients across various industries or the opportunity to specialize in fields such as auditing, stockbroking or consultancy. Recent graduates have joined as assurance associate at Grant Thornton, financial modeller at KPMG and counter risk trader at Barclays Investment Bank.
courses.1x8j:
The Architecture, BA Hons degree, accredited by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA), is the first step to a professional career in architecture. Successful graduates will gain exemption from the RIBA Part 1 examination. This course is also accredited by the Architects Registration Board (ARB).

Teaching is based at the Stockwell Street Building in Heneghan Peng-designed galleries. Studio-based tutorial groups provide all the skills and knowledge students will need via a range of approaches to architectural design.

Students will learn to use design software and gain visual and drawing skills. They'll also study architectural practice, the history of architecture, sustainability, contemporary theory and technology. There will be opportunities to visit art galleries, museums and important buildings and lectures by eminent speakers.

Learners will be taught by an experienced team of experts, which includes senior academics, technical officers, and practitioners with industry experience. Trained postgraduate researchers may also contribute to seminar teaching with the module leader. Teaching is informed by research and writing.

This Architecture, BA Hons course is designed to prepare students for progression into year-out practice in the architectural profession, leading to advanced level study in RIBA/ARB part 2 MArch in Architecture. Therefore, students are not required to take work placements or internships in addition to this pathway.

As well as becoming architects, graduates can pursue opportunities in computer-aided design, animation, urban design, interior design, arts and media, project management, graphic design and the construction industry.
courses.1xb0:
Program Description

The Economist says we’re leading the way in keeping economics degrees relevant. See for yourself on this business economics degree and gain the skills and knowledge needed for a successful career.

Our degree in business economics is designed to provide you with a solid grounding in business. You will be able to apply economic theories and data handling skills to analyse real-world economic and business problems. You will also be trained on how to analyse data using statistical software and databases employed across a variety of industries, giving you experience that's vital for employment and postgraduate study.

You can choose from a number of option modules in different areas of business and economics, enabling you to tailor the course to your areas of interest and career aspirations. Graduates pursue careers in private and public companies, government and non-governmental organisations.
courses.1x8y:
Greenwich's Business Management degree is for newcomers to managerial roles or individuals with some practical managerial experience who wants to develop their management skills across business and management disciplines.

Students will develop a broad understanding of business management essentials by learning about leadership and management skills, business strategy, organizational behavior, cross-cultural management, business research methods, ethics, marketing and finance. They can also choose a project type that suits their interests in the form of dissertation, consultancy project or an international entrepreneurship project.

Learners will emerge with interpersonal and transferable skills and open a world of new opportunities to build a successful career as a business manager or to start their own business. Popular careers for business management graduates include a range of business management roles in the private, public, and voluntary sectors in large companies, SMEs, start-ups, social enterprises, and charities.

Greenwich has an experienced team of academics and industry professionals. Trained postgraduate researchers also contribute to seminar teaching with their latest research-led insight. Teaching is informed by research and consultancy work.

In a typical week learning takes place through a combination of seminars and workshops enabling students to discuss and develop their understanding of topics covered in lectures in smaller groups. They'll also be able to meet their personal tutor. Outside of timetabled sessions, students need to dedicate self-study time to prepare for coursework, presentations and exams. Learners can use Stockwell Street library and online resources to support further reading and research.

In addition, during the week students can also attend additional support classes in some modules, attend guest lectures from industry experts, take part in employability and enterprise workshops and join student societies.

Learners can opt for sandwich work placement route which can last for 9-12 months. However, they are themselves responsible for arranging their placement with support from the university. Previous students have secured a placement year at the NHS, Santander, Net-A-Porter, Intel and Enterprise Rent-A-Car.
courses.4xwy:
