courses.6u88:
This course brings together the latest research on digital media and content creation and will provide students with a detailed understanding of the global media landscape.

Their study key aspects of the media industries, the changes and platforms that have emerged from digitalisation and how content is created across different media.

The course has a focus on understanding creativity and storytelling within all forms of media and how content creation, narrative and media audiences interact in contemporary media environments. Students will learn how stories are constructed across digital media platforms and how multimedia is understood by audiences.

Students will be drawn into a conversation about the international reach of digital media, and how convergence, globalisation and increasing platformisation have altered communications across cultures. The course looks in detail at several key media sectors and how they work, including the use of data platforms, convergence, audiences and semiotoics in contemporary digital media industries.
courses.6bfb:
GCU’s innovative LLM in International Commercial Law is both research-led and informed by practice. It has been created with input from employers and students and draws on multi-disciplinary expertise across the Glasgow School of Business and Society.

Students will study as part of a diverse and engaged international cohort: there are no jurisdictional requirements and there is no expectation that students have already studied Law at undergraduate level.

The course has been carefully designed to appeal to future business leaders, finance professionals, or those who might already be working in a legal role or have undertaken some legal training.

Business, Economics and Law at Glasgow Caledonian University consistently rank highly in league tables and in the National Student Survey. By studying an LLM at Glasgow Caledonian University students will have an exceptional opportunity to become a business leader of the future.
courses.4o1f:
Program Description

Strong financial management is vital to all organisations and the role of the accounting professional is complex, varied and subject to many different pressures. The MSc Accounting, Finance and Regulation course reflects this, covering not only the core areas of accountancy but also key financial and risk topics relevant to students' future career. Regulation is fundamental to accounting and finance and is a feature of many of the modules students will study.

This is an exciting time in the accounting profession with standards evolving and regulatory practices being reviewed and revised. As a student on the MSc Accounting, Finance and Regulation, students will develop a deeper academic and professional knowledge and understanding of the key challenges facing the accounting profession and the wider financial sector.

The accountancy team at Glasgow Caledonian University have a broad range of professional and academic experience which will enhance students' learning as a student on the course. Many of the accountancy academics students will meet have experience working in practice as professional accountants, across key areas such as financial reporting, management accounting, audit and the public sector.

An MSc Accounting, Finance and Regulation from Glasgow Caledonian University will provide students with the confidence and insight to develop their professional career or undertake further postgraduate academic study.

Please be advised that this is the fast track (8 month) option of the MSc Accounting, Finance and Regulation.

courses.8x7b:
The Applied Business Analytics Master of Science programme at Glasgow Caledonian University is designed to prepare students for successful careers in the data-driven business world. It is particularly suited to individuals from business or non-technical backgrounds who wish to expand their expertise into analytics. Students gain sought-after skills in data analytics, visualisation, and programming, while also developing practical business abilities such as leadership and problem-solving.

The programme explores a range of analytical approaches, including identifying trends, forecasting outcomes, and making data-informed decisions. Teaching focuses on the application of analytical techniques to real business challenges, enabling students to put their learning into practice from the outset. The curriculum integrates technical competencies—such as artificial intelligence, programming, and data visualisation—with a strong emphasis on ethical data use, effective communication, and responsible leadership.

Upon completion, graduates will be able to:

  • Apply technical knowledge to real-world business challenges
  • Develop a strategic understanding of data use within legal and ethical frameworks
  • Lead analytics teams and manage data-driven projects
  • Build a strong foundation in programming, data storytelling, and decision-making through industry-standard tools such as Python, SQL, and Power BI.
courses.4oie:
Program Description

Environmental challenges require complex solutions, bringing together scientific, social, political and economic perspectives. GCU's MSc Environmental Management will provide students with the interdisciplinary perspective and diverse skillset to help solve environmental problems in a leadership role. Students can help their communities manage environmental concerns responsibly, making a positive impact and supporting the common good.

This degree course is accredited by the Chartered Institution of Water and Environmental Management (CIWEM), the Chartered Institution of Building Services Engineers (CIBSE) and the Chartered Institution of Wastes Management (CIWM). With the endorsement of four prestigious professional organisations, the MSc Environmental Management offers a respected credential that's relevant to employers around the world.

Students will have the option to complete a general course - giving them a broad understanding across a wide range of environmental disciplines - or choose among four pathways for specialisation.

  • Waste - As society strives to use resources more efficiently, we must ensure waste is properly and safely managed. Students will study sustainable waste management, contaminated land and landfill engineering, reuse and recycling in the manufacturing sector and more.
  • Energy - Global demand for energy has significant environmental implications, and renewable energy is just one part of a broader strategy. Students will explore energy technology, renewable energy, and building and energy performance.
  • Water - Communities depend on clean, plentiful water to survive, but there are water resource challenges around the world. Students will study treatment requirements for the water cycle, policy frameworks for managing supply, international policy, wastewater treatment and more.
  • Oil and Gas - Oil and gas operations pose environmental challenges, particularly off-shore operations. Students will learn about minimising the impact of emissions from oil production, exploring for oil and gas, and environmental regulations.
courses.67fc:
The MSc in Actuarial Management is fully accredited with the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries in the UK for subjects: CP1, CP2, CP3, SP2, SP4, SP5, SP6 and SP9. In addition, studying subject SP9 leads to the internationally recognised Certified Enterprise Risk Actuary (CERA) qualification. It is also possible to "catch up" with some of the earlier subjects that students may have missed – such as CB1, CB2 or CM2.

These subjects cover a variety of areas including life insurance, risk management, investment, derivatives, pensions, communication and modelling. Students choose the best combination for themselves. Completing this degree gets students close to qualification as an actuary, with only one or two exams left to complete after leaving university. It typically speeds up their qualification by one or two years.

Heriot-Watt University is the only Centre of Actuarial Excellence (as recognised by the society of actuaries (SOA) – North America) in Europe. Heriot-Watt has a very active Students' Actuarial Society which won several awards at a recent Heriot-Watt 'Oscars' ceremony. This body is completely managed, enthusiastically and professionally, by its students.
courses.67dy:
Construction Project Management at Heriot-Watt University is one of the longest-running courses of its kind in the UK, equipping graduates with the theoretical knowledge and practical and technical skills to manage people and projects within the construction industry.

A range of core modules covering management, procurement and technology-related subjects will give students a foundation in management principles while providing practical skills relevant to professional practice in construction.

Students will also choose an optional module from a range of subjects drawn from the built environment courses, providing them with a broader understanding of built environment issues and an opportunity to tailor their studies to fit their interests and professional needs.

The University is also a Corporate Member of the Association for Project Management. This course is delivered by the Centre of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, a leading body recognised by the Royal Academy of Engineering. This is one of four such centres established at UK universities that jointly form a national network to demonstrate and exchange best practice in teaching and research for the sustainable built environment. Students tend to come from the construction industry, bringing with them practical experience in a variety of built environment roles, or from other professional backgrounds but with an interest in converting to a career in the construction industry. This course offers a number of guest lectures each year specific to the modules where experienced professionals from industry visit to share their knowledge and experience with students.
courses.67e0:
This Data Science masters teaches the theory and skills for managing and analysing large, complex data sets – sometimes called Big Data. Students will learn how to model, store and process these data sets using the latest algorithms and techniques. Modern methods and tools for visually exploring the data will also be covered. The MSc course offers the key skill set of a data scientist. Optional courses provide an opportunity to explore closely-related areas based on the internationally leading research work of Heriot-Watt's academics.

The MSc is accredited by the British Computer Society. Whether students come from a relevant honours degree or an industry position in finance or business this programme will meet their ambition and equip them with a wealth of globally attractive and highly employable qualities.

  • Competitive Strategy
  • Research Philosophy and Practice
  • Business Economics.

Build your understanding of materials science and specialise in biomaterials and tissue engineering on this professionally accredited Master’s degree.

Technological advances in materials science and engineering (MSE) are transforming our lives in a range of areas, from targeted drug delivery and disease detection, to tissue engineered scaffolds.

During your studies, you'll analyse how materials innovations solve real problems in fields such as healthcare and medical devices.

In this course, students will learn how to identify, assess and manage strategic, organizational, environmental and technological risks, as well as threats presented by unpredictable situations.

They'll get the knowledge and skills needed to become a proficient and capable risk manager, honing analytical and problem-solving abilities that are highly valued by employers.

Study our Arts in AI & Data in Culture and Society MA in the Department of Digital Humanities in the Faculty of Arts & Humanities, King's College London

Explore how AI and data are transforming culture, society, politics and everyday life. AI is increasingly embedded in everyday life, from chatbots and image generation to recommendation algorithms and autonomous agents. As these technologies develop, they raise important questions about privacy, power and the evolving relationship between humans and machines.

Our MA in AI and Data in Culture and Society explores how AI is reshaping social, cultural, political and economic processes and generating knowledge. You’ll examine how data are transformed into representations, models and forms of machine memory that shape what AI systems can know, predict and do.

This research-driven multidisciplinary programme combines technical skills with humanities and social science perspectives. You’ll learn to collect and analyse data, programme in Python (including AI assisted coding), use emerging AI tools and assistants and explore machine learning concepts, including representations, embeddings and model behaviour. You’ll also examine the legal and policy frameworks shaping AI and data, including through a module taught by The Dickson Poon School of Law.

You will also gain an appreciation of the importance of accountability and information, corporate governance, financial management and valuation and ethics in global financial markets.

The Accounting, Accountability & Financial Management MSc is a multidisciplinary programme designed to develop your accounting and financial management skills and provide you with the capabilities required for global business success. You will study Financial Reporting and Analysis, Financial Management, and Management Accounting & Control. Criteria for entry on to the UK Register of Architects are prescribed by the Architects Registration Board (ARB). The ARB and the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) have agreed to hold the criteria in common and successful completion of the MArch degree gives Part 2 exemption.

In addition to this, the RIBA has introduced new Themes and Values for Architectural Education. This includes further focus on climate literacy, health and life safety, ethical practice, and research literacy. The modules in the programme work within this framework to provide a coherent balance of intellectual and practical skills, as well as working to develop students' transferable skills.

The course sits in the Department of Landscape and Architecture, part of the Faculty of Kingston School of Art (KSA). It is located in the compact Knights Park campus, alongside the range of other creative disciplines within KSA. It has immediate access to excellent and wide-ranging resources for physical making. This opportunity sits at the heart of the pedagogy in KSA and forms a key component of the MArch Architecture programme. Knights Park is a place in which to converse, to debate, to work and to learn from each other.

Kingston University is at the forefront of practice-led European architectural discourse. The Architecture MArch qualification is prescribed by the ARB. This course covers both ARB and RIBA criteria Part 2. This course centres on the practice and theory, techniques and contexts of architectural design. It includes live making projects and engagement with practice and research.

Students will deepen and consolidate the knowledge, understanding and skills acquired during their first degree and a recommended period of work-based learning. A dissertation will give students the chance to investigate an area of interest in depth.
courses.25f1:
For those who are interested in developing a career in the commercial art world, this course will prepare them for the opportunities lying ahead. Students will develop the key skills and gain the knowledge to understand global art markets in the context of their ever-changing artistic, cultural and economic environments.

Making the most of its location in Europe's art market capital in London, this Art Business MA degree draws on a high standard of interdisciplinary academic and practical teaching by recognised industry professionals. It also offers insights from art market practitioners, both those with long-standing careers and those who are rising entrepreneurs of the millennial generation. The curriculum is carefully designed to balance skills training with academic rigour, and to combine core business and legal concepts with industry-specific knowledge in order to reflect the diverse professional landscape students will enter on graduation. The students will benefit from frequent field trips to different art businesses, including galleries, auction houses and art fairs.

The course is delivered in partnership with the Kingston Business School, enabling students to benefit from the know-how of business school experts, as well as from the creative and stimulating atmosphere of the Kingston School of Art. This unique partnership makes Kingston the only institution in the country to deliver an Art Business programme within the environment of a business school.

Kingston University allow students to do a 12-month work placement as part of their course. The responsibility for finding the work placement is with the student; the University cannot guarantee the work placement, just the opportunity to undertake it. As the work placement is an assessed part of the course, it is covered by a student's Student Route visa.

Graduates from the Art Business MA course set up galleries and online platforms, manage collections and advise collectors, work for auction houses or galleries. More and more students set up their own companies or expand their current businesses.
courses.69q3:
The course is project-based; each module aiming to equip students with a robust portfolio with which to enter the creative industries. Students will learn clean modelling techniques, principles of animation, lighting, shading, texturing, rigging, rendering and compositing.

Students will collaborate in a studio environment as part of a team with students from other digital media courses. Industry-standard production techniques and tools will simulate a professional environment. Students will use facilities with high-spec workstations, including brand-new Wacom Cintiq Pro 24" HD tablets. Students also have access to a digital media studio, motion capture suite and kits including Rokoko MoCap suits.

Kingston University is an active member of The Independent Game Developers' Association (TIGA) and the British Interactive Media Association (BIMA). The technical and creative skills provided by this Computer Animation course are applicable in areas related mainly to the movie and games industry. Furthermore, advertisement, 3D printing, architectural design and web-based modelling are areas that require skills and knowledge on modelling, texturing, rigging, animation, and compositing. Graduates have go on to work at Industrial Light and Magic, Kuato Studios, AccuCities.

It is very important for students to prepare and apply themselves if this is the route they wish to take. Employers look for great written and oral communication skills and an excellent CV/portfolio. courses.1wle:
Students will learn in workshops, one-to-one or in small groups, with support from practising and published writers, and fellow students. Kingston's award-winning former creative writing students include Booker-shortlisted Oyinkan Braithwaite, Joe Pierson, who won the Bridport Prize, Stefan Mohammed, awarded the Dylan Thomas Prize, Bafta-winner, Sarah Woolner, the acclaimed poet Dom Bury and celebrated novelist Faiqa Mansab.

With a full programme of workshops and critical study, this Creative Writing MA offers students the chance to work on their own writing in different genres with the support of published practitioners.

The Writers' Workshop module will encourage students to develop their writing 'voice' through engagement with fellow students across a range of genres (in fiction or creative non-fiction), while the Special Study module enables them to specialise in one genre, such as fiction, non-fiction, poetry or drama.

This Creative Writing MA will give students the knowledge and confidence to enter the cultural debate and to begin to identify outlets for their own writing. Students will have the opportunity to contribute to Kingston University's publication, Ripple, which includes fiction, poetry, reviews and creative non-fiction and is edited by students on the course.
courses.8nqs: The MA Early Years degree allows students to examine current practice and policy while developing their knowledge of early years settings. Students will gain a systematic understanding of key national and global issues relating to Early Years Education, build critical awareness of theory and practice, and strengthen their research skills. The course suits professionals across various contexts including education, social care, and health, helping them enhance both their professional practice and career prospects in this important field.
courses.8nqt: The MA Education degree allows students to examine educational issues that matter to them professionally. Students will build advanced knowledge to develop their expertise and enhance their practice through academic study combined with practical application. By completing this programme, students will gain a critical understanding of educational theory and practice, strengthen their skills in their chosen areas, and boost their career prospects. The programme is designed to meet the needs of educators from various sectors including primary, secondary, further and higher education, private providers, and non-profit organisations.
courses.8nqr: The MA Education (English as an Additional Language) programme allows students to examine current theory and practice while developing practical strategies for supporting EAL learners. Students will gain advanced knowledge of classroom techniques, whole-school approaches, and research-informed practices for EAL pupils at compulsory school age. The course suits professionals across various educational settings, from classroom teachers to senior leaders, helping them enhance both their understanding and career prospects in this growing field.
courses.8nqo: Whether students are looking to extend their skills for English language teaching or they intend to work in international school settings and need to know how to support students in multilingual and multicultural classrooms, the MA in Education with TESOL is the ideal course for them. This course allows students to further their knowledge of education policy for social inclusion and diversity and implement it in their school.
courses.8nqq: The MA Educational Leadership degree sets students up to make meaningful impact within their professional context. Students will gain advanced knowledge of leadership theory and practice, develop a critical understanding of educational policy, and strengthen their research capabilities. This course will equip them with the knowledge and skills needed to foster strong leadership within their area of interest and inspire the best outcomes from those who lead.
courses.8nqn:
The MA Health and Social Care Leadership course aims to enable an in-depth knowledge and understanding of leadership practice in Health and Social Care, informed by current scholarly research and including a critical awareness of current issues and developments at the forefront of this field.

This course aims to enable an in-depth knowledge and understanding of leadership practice in Health and Social Care, informed by current scholarly research and including a critical awareness of current issues and developments at the forefront of this field. It is ideal for advanced practitioners, supervisors and managers working or volunteering in H and SC who have extensive experience in practice, and whose current role is to support and challenge those working in the field.
courses.7dio: In a global business environment, characterised by constant change; the MBA is an excellent choice for those wishing to advance their careers. Our MBA programme is designed to develop leaders who can navigate the complexities of today's dynamic business environment. The Hope MBA is distinct in that a focus on ethics, responsible and sustainable leadership drive the curriculum. Choosing the Hope MBA is an investment in students' future, equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and network needed to thrive in an ever changing global business environment. We understand that successful leaders are central to transforming and driving change within organizations and beyond. Our curriculum is designed to develop strategic thinking, effective decision making, and a global perspective, essential attributes for leaders shaping the future of business. Through embedding principles of corporate social responsibility and environmental stewardship into our curriculum, we aim to develop leaders that will transform organizations for a common good.
courses.539u:
The Digital Media MA course will enable students to take advantage of the dramatic rise in career opportunities within the digital media sector. Students will learn skills in interactive media content creation, interactive design, digital media production, social media management, digital media project management and much more.

As the interactive media industry reaches its maturity, employers are searching for qualified professionals with a diverse range of skills and knowledge. This master’s course will help students develop the expertise employers are looking for.

This programme will teach students how to manage successful projects. This will begin with the assessment and selection of the appropriate tools and software applications for producing a digital media project. They'll also learn how to develop digital media and social media strategies.

Students will then study how to manage production teams and communicate effectively in a professional media environment. By the end of the programme, students should be able to confidently navigate the complexity of the international digital media and creative industries.

Students will study current topics in areas of design including:

  • Interactive Media
  • The Internet and its Applications
  • Digital Solutions For Private Industry and the Public Sector
  • Usability Design
  • Effective Digital Media Project Management
  • Digital Audiences and Audience Research
  • Social Media Management
  • Digital Media Strategy
  • Digital Interactive Television
  • Mobile Communications and New Media Ownership

Students will develop skills in relevant multimedia software including Adobe Creative Cloud to ensure their practical skills are in line with the latest thinking and practices in digital media.

An International Bright Futures Scholarship in the amount of £3,000 will automatically be applied to eligible students with overseas fee status starting a degree with London Met in the 2024/25 academic year. This scholarship includes a tuition fee reduction for the duration of students' studies and is applicable to both undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Tuition Deposit is £4,000 for all students excluding those from Punjab and Haryana for whom the deposit amount will remain at 50%
courses.539v:
This Education MA degree is designed to provide students with a broad range of knowledge and skills within the field of education. This course will provide students with opportunities to develop and enhance their professional skills and understanding, so that students can progress within or embark on a career within the sector.

This diverse course covers a range of disciplines, drawing from areas such as curriculum theory, psychology of learning and human potential, sociology of gender, social class, race, philosophy and the history of education.

This course aims to introduce students to key academic and professional debates within the field, helping them to develop a professional voice and standpoint. Upon successful completion of this course, London Metropolitan University hopes that students will feel enthused about returning to the field and feel intellectually empowered to initiate change.

A key theme embedded in this master’s degree is social justice. This course is aligned with the Education for Social Justice (ESJ) strategy to ensure equity in the curriculum practice.

The modules have been developed to broaden the knowledge and meaning of the term ‘education’, as well as its purpose from being a ‘product’ to understanding how the curriculum is managed and led. Students will also explore its influence on children’s learning, assessment and life chances. This degree has five core 20 credit modules:

  • Curriculum, Pedagogy and Assessment
  • Curriculum Leadership
  • Critical Theory and Education
  • Research Methods in Education
  • Education Dissertation

Specialist option modules allow students to explore subjects that are of particular interest to them in more detail, such as:

  • Applying Learning Technologies
  • Issues in Language Learning: An Intercultural Approach
  • Reflective Practice
  • Social Justice Education
  • Web-based Learning and Teaching
  • Understanding the Language Classroom

If students have a particular interest in studying women abuse, they are also able to choose from the following option modules:

  • Sexual Violence: Causes, Consequences and Interventions
  • Violence against Women: Issues, Research and Policy

If there’s a specific topic students would like to study in more detail that does not appear here, they can choose an alternative education-focused topic in agreement with a subject supervisor.

An International Bright Futures Scholarship in the amount of £3,000 will automatically be applied to eligible students with overseas fee status starting a degree with London Met in the 2024/25 academic year. This scholarship includes a tuition fee reduction for the duration of students' studies and is applicable to both undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Tuition Deposit is £4,000 for all students excluding those from Punjab and Haryana for whom the deposit amount will remain at 50%
courses.7ewo:
This MA will provide students with opportunities to develop and enhance their professional skills and knowledge so they can progress within or embark on a career within the early childhood studies sector. This course is likely to appeal to students with an undergraduate degree in early childhood studies.

This diverse course covers a range of disciplines, drawing from areas such as curriculum theory, psychology of learning and human potential, identity and self in the early years, sociology of gender, social class, race, philosophy and the critical discourses in early childhood studies.

This degree aims to introduce students to key academic and professional debates within the field of education and an opportunity to focus on early childhood and the early years, helping them to develop a professional perspective and standpoint. Upon successful completion of this course, it is hoped that students will feel enthused about continuing in the sector and feel intellectually empowered to initiate change.

A key theme embedded in this master’s degree is social justice. This course is aligned with the Education for Social Justice (ESJ) framework to ensure equity in the curriculum practice.

The modules have been developed to broaden the knowledge and meaning of the term ‘education’, as well as its purpose from being a ‘product’ to understanding how the curriculum is managed and led. Education is a creative and powerful endeavour in which curriculum and pedagogy come together to support children's learning whilst widening their future life chances.

This degree can be completed as a postgraduate diploma by taking four core modules and two optional modules. Students could also choose to study for a Postgraduate Certificate in Education by choosing to study the following three core modules: Critical Theory and Education; Curriculum Leadership; Curriculum, Pedagogy and Assessment.

Applications are welcomed from practising teachers and if they already hold a relevant PGCE qualification, they may be able to apply for credit and study fewer modules to complete this MA.

An International Bright Futures Scholarship in the amount of £3,000 will automatically be applied to eligible students with overseas fee status starting a degree with London Met in the 2024/25 academic year. This scholarship includes a tuition fee reduction for the duration of students' studies and is applicable to both undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Tuition Deposit is £4,000 for all students excluding those from Punjab and Haryana for whom the deposit amount will remain at 50%
courses.53e8:
This Master's degree is designed for teachers and language professionals to learn how to teach the English language. The course is also suitable if students don't have any teaching experience.

London Metropolitan University has a diverse cohort so students will benefit from a varied learning experience. Students will explore new theories and conversation around language, teaching languages and learning in various social and educational environments.

Students will explore language pedagogy, linguistics, sociolinguistics in relation to theory and practice on this English Language Teaching MA. Students will also learn about topics such as the psychology of language and language testing.

Students will develop the skills needed to become an employable language teacher, policy maker, educator or researcher. On this course, students will take part in discussions on language, undertake reading and be supported through research, plus students will have the opportunity to go into schools and understand the English language teaching process.

The teaching team are experienced practitioners who have published work and research in the sector. Research topics have included the processes of second language learning and teaching and English as a second language and English as a foreign language in higher education.

This Master's degree explores the sociocultural, political, economic and cultural aspects of how the English language is learned, taught and used worldwide.

The reflexive and reflective element of this course aims to improve in students' practice by encouraging them to think of themselves as a global language professional.

There are no exams. Students will be assessed through a variety of methods including coursework, essays, presentations, research and a final dissertation.

An International Bright Futures Scholarship in the amount of £3,000 will automatically be applied to eligible students with overseas fee status starting a degree with London Met in the 2024/25 academic year. This scholarship includes a tuition fee reduction for the duration of students' studies and is applicable to both undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Tuition Deposit is £4,000 for all students excluding those from Punjab and Haryana for whom the deposit amount will remain at 50%
courses.6niv:
The Master of Architecture in Architecture at the London South Bank University promotes a studio-based culture which encourages debate and enquiry about contemporary societies, the postmodern city, and relationships between urban and landscape conditions. Students will consider these through a range of innovative and personal responses to architectural design projects; environmental and constructional technologies; critical research expressed in extended, structured writing, and the skills needed to operate as a progressive professional practitioner.

This course will see students build on analytical design skills and professional competences established at undergraduate level, with a focus on innovation in design, construction, and resource efficient technology. Working in vertical design studios, they will develop an understanding of, and methods relevant to contemporary professional practice, together with an ability to produce complex and diverse design proposals.
courses.6nkh:
Students who are passionate about current and emerging challenges facing towns, cities and rural areas, want to help shape people's future built and natural environments and want to study planning at the heart of one of the world’s most exciting cities then the Master of Arts in Town and Country Planning provide the answer. The courses focus on interactions between people and place and how to facilitate high quality developments in the right location.

This course is fully accredited by the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI). With two years relevant work experience, students can apply to take the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) Assessment of Professional Competence exam.

The academic staff have expertise in a range of planning related fields and are all research active with a strong track record in national and international research networks, projects and publications.
courses.6nki:
The Master of Arts in Urban Design and Planning focuses on urban design as part of town planning, giving students the opportunity to develop their understanding of urban design and development issues through working at different scales of the city and engaging with theoretical debates.

‘Planning’ is both a design and public policy profession. It deals with design as a professional and a democratic practice, showing how professional knowledge and deep engagement with communities are both essential if places are to achieve lasting functionality and liveability.
courses.74yk:
The Master of Science in Accounting and Finance has been designed to provide an academic route to students' continuing professional development and enhance their career opportunities or be a stepping stone to further research.

This course explores contemporary and specialized approaches in accounting and finance. The ever-changing legal framework in which the financial sector operates, combined with the latest developments in accounting and reporting, call for key practical, theoretical, and empirical issues to be further analyzed through further academic research.

Graduates will have access to prestigious resources, such as the Bloomberg computer suite, to analyze company and industry data from companies and organizations across the world.

This qualification is designed for learners who wish to pursue a career in the financial services industry, professional accountancy, banking, and finance or management. Learners will be equipped with the essential skills and knowledge needed to pursue high-level careers in all types of organizations in the public and private sector and within industry and commerce.

courses.22ub:
Loughborough University's Master of Arts/Master of Science in Design Innovation programme will help students engage with design and innovation as drivers for change in organisations, generating insight from across the creative and strategic domains.

They will learn from the most influential thought leaders, pioneering researchers and creative innovators, who will expose them to the latest theories and developments in the field.

They will have access to the latest knowledge, debates and issues in design and innovation, enhancing their creative, strategic and collaboration skills through a mixture of active learning and project work.

Each module will develop their design innovation knowledge by analysing and evaluating current practices, issues and debates and provide them with the opportunity to respond to genuine industry challenges.

The inspiring learning environment will encourage them to think creatively and improve their effectiveness as a professional in the fields of design, innovation and strategy.
courses.22ur:
Digital media and creative industries are a fast-growing sector, opening new and exciting career opportunities for those with the right combination of knowledge and skills. By undertaking Loughborough University's Digital Media and Creative Industries Master of Arts students will be equipped with cutting-edge skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in the digital and creative economy.

In today’s increasingly digital and interconnected landscape, creativity is a driving force behind global economies. As the world becomes more digitally connected, there is growing demand for individuals with diverse skill sets and innovative minds. The Digital Media and Creative Industries Master's programme is designed to equip graduates with the expertise to be at the forefront of this fast-paced, creative, and ever-evolving industry.

This programme offers the perfect blend of theory and hands-on experience empowering students to curate their own specializations within the digital media and creative industries. The programme is highly flexible, offering customized pathways which focus on promotional cultures and industries, digital media industries, and creative industries.

The core modules are designed to cultivate student's conceptual and contextual understanding of developments in digital media and the creative industries. They will have the opportunity to explore a range of topics from digital platforms and network society and culture, through to cultural policies and the creative economy. In optional modules they can fine-tune their skills and shape their expertise. From advertising and creative campaigning to harnessing the power of digital media applications, preserving digital heritage, exploring cultural institutions, and delving into social identities and media, they will engage with the latest cutting-edge research and developments in the field of media and creative industries.
courses.225p:
Loughborough University's Construction Management Master of Science programme enjoys a great heritage, being the longest established in the United Kingdom and the second oldest in the world. The programme is continually evolving to equip graduates with the core skills needed to succeed as a construction professional and provides the widest possible range of module options, allowing students to pursue individual interests within the construction management field.

Construction projects have become more complex in our changing world, where there are increasing concerns regarding sustainability and social value. The Construction Management program is suitable for those who wish to combine project management expertise with more managerial business expertise. The programme offers the most flexible module selection compared to other construction programmes.

The School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering is one of four Royal Academy of Engineering Centres of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, and one of the most highly funded built environment groups by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC).
courses.225q:
Loughborough University has been teaching construction at postgraduate level longer than any other university in the United Kingdom. The Construction Project Management Master of Science programme delivers core technical project management expertise while providing a holistic perspective of the construction project processes and the challenge of project management in complex building and infrastructure projects.

Competency in project management has become a crucial skill set of all construction professionals and executives, with many construction project managers functioning in a strategic and coordinating role in the delivery of the client’s physical development and investment programme. This program is designed to further develop these competencies and advance students' career within the construction industry.

The School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering is one of four Royal Academy of Engineering Centres of Excellence in Sustainable Building Design, and one of the most highly funded built environment groups by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC).
courses.1j1y:
All industries now utilise data and Applied AI and Data Science and Data-Analytics are increasingly identified as key industrial activities. The position of Data Scientist is rapidly becoming a required post for any company that wishes to take full advantage of the data that they collect. This course is designed to give students the skills to step into a career as a Data Scientist in a wide range of industries and companies.

This masters has been designed to offer those with a familiarity in maths, science or computing an opportunity to develop a key set of skills for future employment in a way that builds on students' existing knowledge and skill base. Upon completing the course, students will be ready to fulfil the requirements of a Data Scientist.

Students will focus on the intertwining areas of machine learning, visual analytics and data governance, and be able to strike a balance between theoretical underpinnings, practical hands-on experience, and acquisition of industrially-relevant languages and packages. Students will also be exposed to cutting-edge contemporary research activity within data science that will equip them with the potential to pursue a research-based career, and, in particular, further PhD study at Middlesex University.
courses.1j20:
This Master of Science - Data Science with Integrated Placement course has been designed to offer those with a familiarity in mathematical science or computing an opportunity to develop a set of skills for future employment in a way that builds on their existing knowledge and skills. After finishing the course, they will be ready to enter a career as a data scientist.

They will focus on the interconnected areas of machine learning, visual analytics, and data governance, and learn to strike a balance between theory, practice, and the acquisition of industrially relevant languages and packages.

They will also be exposed to cutting-edge contemporary research activity within data science that will equip them with the potential to pursue a research-based career, and, in particular, further PhD study at Middlesex.
courses.1j22:
Digital will continue to change the face of marketing for many years to come. Those who succeed will need knowledge of the consumer and how today digital marketing and analytics is at the heart of marketing. Aspiring marketers need to understand the digital consumer and how the tools of digital work in practice; as well as the latest frameworks to plan, implement and evaluate digital marketing activity.

With a Masters in Digital Marketing, students will prepare themselves to meet the needs of organisations across a variety of sectors by developing skills in crucial areas such as e-marketing, consumer psychology, and more.

This course will prepare students for a successful career with a comprehensive take on digital marketing and a strong emphasis on the application of theory to practice, in subject areas such as e-marketing, social media, analytics, consumer psychology and digital advertising. It has been designed for graduates who have studies in fields such as marketing, media, management and social sciences, as well as professionals working in marketing across public, private and voluntary sectors seeking specialist knowledge and career development.

Embedding an understanding of digital marketing strategies, dynamics and platforms, students will take the knowledge and skills developed in the course and apply them to a variety of practice based, real-life learning will complement theory.
courses.1j29:
Program Description

Environmental health is the branch of public health concerned with how people's living, working and leisure environments affect their health. It's a gripping subject to study and a fascinating field to work in. Whether students are helping improve the living conditions of society's poorest, or working with a company to improve health and safety for staff and customers, their work will have a huge, life-changing and often life-saving impact.

This course is highly work-focused, with a strong emphasis on practical laboratory work and real-life case studies and students will be able to take advantage of Middlesex University's close links within the industry.

The course is centred on UK law and practice, but is designed to be flexible and provide education and training that will be valuable internationally. Students will have access to a range of excellent facilities including a microbiology laboratory and pestology materials. They will be able to study specialist modules areas such as food safety, and health and safety which are particularly valued by both local authorities and the private sector.

Many of the teaching staff are chartered environmental health practitioners and under their expert guidance, previous students have done research into a wide variety of areas, including listeria in food, the effects of heavy smoking, skin lightening, water pollution and the attitudes of people living in high-rise buildings towards recycling.
courses.1j2d:
Program Description

An effective supply chain goes beyond the successful input and output of goods and services. With the right management, a supply chain has the power to influence entire business processes, create value and unite multiple organisations from all over the world. This complex discipline, with elements of IT, logistics and procurement, is increasingly important in today's globalised environment of interconnected networks.

In recent decades, organisations have become increasingly reliant on effective supply chains in order to compete in the global market. This Middlesex University course equips students with a global view of the strategic and operational processes they need to manage the key functions of these supply chain processes, including transportation, warehousing, inventory management and production planning. Middlesex University combines advanced theory teaching with practical skills training in well-known software such as SAP®and Arena® to give students a core understanding of the contemporary issues and programs used in global supply chain management.

With easy access to the corporate world from the London campus, students will develop methods of strategic and critical thinking to enhance their ability to effectively manage and improve existing structures within domestic and international companies. This real-world focus to the course ensures that students are able to respond to a variety of challenges with confidence and ingenuity, enhancing their ability to lead and helping them to advance into more senior roles quickly and capably.
courses.737o:
The MA Philosophy and Artificial Intelligence combines exploration of a range of philosophical issues, including ethical issues related to computer data, with opportunities to develop the skills and techniques of data science. Poised at the intersection of the humanities and technology, this innovative masters degree can equip you with the combination of thinking, communication, and technical skills currently sought by employers in sectors ranging from financial and professional services, to the creative industries, government and policy-making.

Presupposing no background in either philosophy or programming, it ensures students are equipped with the skills and knowledge needed for graduate study in philosophy, and offers opportunities to acquire relevant coding abilities, and knowledge of the techniques of data science that underpin recent advances in machine learning and artificial intelligence, should students so desire.

At the same time, the programme allows for a progressive exploration of ethical and other philosophical issues arising in this area, with courses directly addressing them, and a dissertation devoted to a detailed investigation of an approved topic of the student’s choosing.
courses.87wr:
MSc International Business: Leading in an Evolving Global Workplace

The Master of Science in International Business is designed to prepare graduates to navigate and lead within today’s rapidly changing global environment. Emphasising contemporary management practices and people-centric innovation, the programme cultivates advanced knowledge in organisational strategy, human resource management, marketing, and strategic decision-making.

In response to evolving workplace dynamics—driven by artificial intelligence, remote work, and shifting workforce expectations—the programme provides participants with the critical skills required to align organisational performance with effective people management. A range of specialised modules are available, including negotiation, innovation, and leadership with a focus on sustainability.

Furthermore, students have the opportunity to consolidate their learning through an optional experiential project conducted in a real-world business context.

Whether seeking to advance an existing career or transition into a leadership role, graduates of the MSc in International Business are well-equipped to succeed in the complex and competitive landscape of international commerce.

This Master of Science in International Business provides graduates with a comprehensive understanding of international management and people-focused leadership, equipping them to navigate the complexities of today’s global business environment.

Master key business functions – The programme fosters expertise in areas such as business growth, marketing, ethics, and finance, examined through a variety of lenses including those of customers, shareholders, society, governance, and the environment.

Address real-world business challenges – Students acquire practical tools and methodologies to formulate strategic, evidence-based solutions to complex international business issues.

Lead with confidence – By integrating core business knowledge with advanced people management capabilities, the programme prepares graduates to drive innovation and effect meaningful change across global organisations.

Develop self-awareness and professional impact – Participants are encouraged to reflect on their professional identity and develop the competencies required to become high-value contributors within diverse organisational settings.

Overall, the programme is designed to cultivate critical thinking, strategic decision-making, and the capacity to make a lasting, positive impact within the field of international business.
courses.7h0w: The MA Luxury Brand Management programme aims to develop an innovative approach to the professional luxury brand management of luxury consumable goods (cars, cosmetics, drinks, fashion, fragrances, handbags, jewellery, luggage, yachts and watches) in this growing market. The programme provides you with the critical knowledge and awareness of the complex issues involved in the luxury consumable goods sector in the 21st century, working on concepts and platforms such as brand management, marketing, advertising and social media.
