arden-university.about:
Arden University provides access to the skills, knowledge, and opportunities learners need to further their careers and achieve the success they deserve.

As an innovative and applied university, Arden’s cutting-edge digital learning platforms contain all the support students need to succeed. The University was recognised in the latest National Student Survey in 2025 as No 5 in the UK for student satisfaction and has more than 40,000 ambitious students learning with it. The university built its courses to reflect the needs of today’s students and employers, with many of its courses being developed hand in hand with modern business organisations.

Arden's industry accreditation and partnerships with institutions like the NHS, CMI, and CIPD provide students with the resources, insight, and opportunities to transform their careers and make a positive contribution to their communities.

Why Arden University - Manchester

  • Location: Located in one of the UK’s most exciting and diverse cities, Arden University’s Manchester campus offers everything students need to succeed in their studies and shape their future career. International students will find a warm welcome, modern learning spaces, and dedicated support to help them settle into the city. Manchester itself is one of the country’s most vibrant student cities, known for its diversity, culture, and friendliness, making it the perfect place to learn, grow, and feel at home.
  • Student Satisfaction: Arden University's MBA is ranked the Best MBA in the UK by the CEO Magazine, 2024 and 2025. The University is also ranked Top 5 in the UK for Student Experience by NSS 2025. Over 90% of their students agree that staff make their subject engaging, say their course is developing the skills they need for the future, and believe that the library resources fully support their learning.
  • Scholarships: Arden University believes that everyone, everywhere has the right to higher education. They understand that studying abroad can bring additional financial challenges. That’s why they offer a range of scholarships and regional funding options designed specifically for international students.
  • Learning Success Hub: Academic Skills Tutors at the Manchester campus are there to help students develop key academic skills for success. On-campus academic support is available every day, including face-to-face, online workshops, 1:1 sessions, dissertation support (pilot programme), and "On Track” drop-ins at key points in the academic year. Arden also offers collaboration with Peer Mentors to provide additional support when and where students need it.
  • Career Support: From the very first day, Arden University helps students plan and progress their careers. Whether students are working towards a promotion, building their CV, or exploring a new field, Arden's Careers Team provides expert guidance every step of the way. On the Manchester campus, they offer 1:1 careers appointments, weekly careers drop-ins, helping finding part-time jobs and work experience, employer events, access to specialist careers tools, and career and professional development workshops.
arden-university.accommodation: Arden University advises students to begin looking for accommodation near their chosen campus as soon as possible. Finding the right place to live is key to a positive student experience. Although Arden does not offer on-campus accommodation, they do support students as they find their home away from home. Arden's Accommodation Officers will assist students in finding suitable accommodation and provide ongoing support throughout their stay.

aston-university-oncampus-centre.about:
ONCAMPUS Aston is based on the campus of Aston University located in the city of Birmingham. As a top 30 UK university, Aston was the pioneer of the placement year and is renowned for its focus on employability and entrepreneurship.

Aston has been named as University of the Year 2020 (The Guardian) and awarded Outstanding Entrepreneurial University 2020 (Times Higher Education). Aston Business School has also been ranked in the top 100 European Business Schools by the Financial Times in 2020.

Students who study at ONCAMPUS Aston are guaranteed progression to Aston University following the successful completion of a Foundation Programme.

Why Aston University - ONCAMPUS

  • Internationally Recognized: Aston University was awarded University of the Year by The Guardian (2020), Outstanding Entrepreneurial University by Times Higher Education (2020), and awarded the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) Gold for Teaching Excellence.
  • Location: Aston University is located in Birmingham, a diverse, multi-cultural hub for business and industry that has been recognized as the most diverse entrepreneurial region by Start-up Britain. Birmingham is also located less than 90 minutes from London and Manchester and has great links to Europe with the airport located just a 10 minute train ride from the city.
  • Facilities and Campus Life: Aston offers a wide range of sports and fitness facilities, including a 25m swimming pool, a state of the art gym, sports halls, grass pitches, and all-weather pitches. The school also offers over 130 student-led groups, meaning there is something to appeal to any and all interests!
  • Guaranteed Progression: Students who study at ONCAMPUS Aston are guaranteed progression to Aston University upon successful completion of a Foundation Programme.

bangor-university.about:
Established in 1884, Bangor University has a long tradition of excellence and exceeds expectations, both for academic standards and student experience. Bangor is a strong, confident institution recognised regionally, nationally and internationally as a centre of excellence for its varied portfolio of teaching and research, and for the unique, multicultural, inclusive experience it provides for its staff and students.

Bangor University has a long tradition of academic excellence and a strong focus on the student experience. Around 10,000 students currently study at the University, with teaching staff based within fourteen Academic Schools. It is ranked in the top 40 in the UK for research*, according to the Research Excellence Framework (REF) 2014. The REF recognised that more than three-quarters of Bangor’s research is either world-leading or internationally excellent, ahead of the average for UK universities. Research is central to Bangor University; it is an integral part of its teaching and a passion of all academic staff. The 2014 Research Excellence Framework recognised that more than three-quarters of Bangor’s research is either world-leading or internationally excellent, ahead of the average for all UK universities. Bangor researchers come from over 30 countries worldwide, and collaborate with colleagues from over 120 nations.

Why Bangor University?

  • Location: Students can live in one of the most scenic locations in the UK as they study. Nestled between the mountains and the sea, Bangor is more than just beautiful: it’s a playground for nature lovers. Hike, climb, kayak or canoe in nearby Snowdonia National Park, head to the beaches on Anglesey or take the plunge on Europe's fastest zip wire.
  • Clubs and Societies: The award winning Students' Union clubs and societies are all free to join. Students have around 200 to choose from so they are bound to find something they like. In the 2020 What Uni Student Choice Awards, Bangor University was voted 2nd in the UK for Sport and Societies. The location near Snowdonia also means that adventure is on the doorstep.
  • Teaching Excellence: Bangor offers the highest quality teaching in a supportive learning environment and students can be assured that they will be taught by lecturers who want to see them thrive. The Gold award in the UK government’s Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) reflects a commitment to ensuring students succeed. Bangor was given the highest possible award due to teaching quality and students’ learning outcomes.

bangor-university-international-college.about:
Bangor University International College (BUIC) is a specialist Embedded College offering Incorporated Programmes, where international students can begin their studies at Bangor University. BUIC delivers the first stages of the International Incorporated Bachelors Degree, International Year One, and the International Incorporated Masters. Whilst Oxford International holds responsibility for the academic provision, all quality assurance and maintenance of quality standards for all teaching at the Bangor University International College remains strictly with Bangor University.

Student's time at Bangor University International College is part of their degree. Following successful completion of Stage 1 BUIC, students will continue their studies directly with Bangor University. This means by attending the college, students can complete their degree in four years at the undergraduate level, or two years at postgraduate level.

Why Bangor University International College

  • Small Class Sizes: Smaller class sizes mean that students will receive ample individual support and attention from their tutors as they acquire knowledge and understanding of core subjects.
  • Diverse Academic Community: BUIC hosts students from all over the world, so students will have the opportunity to learn about different cultures, broaden their horizons, and make life-long friendships.
  • Location: Students can live in one of the most scenic locations in the UK as they study. Nestled between the mountains and the sea, Bangor is more than just beautiful: it's a playground for nature lovers.

bath-spa-university.about:
Bath Spa University is a UK-based institution renowned for its emphasis on creativity, culture, and enterprise. It offers a diverse range of programs across arts, sciences, education, social sciences, and business, aiming to equip students with the skills and support needed to pursue their passions .

Established in 1852 as the Bath School of Art, the university has a rich heritage in the arts. Notably, artists such as Walter Sickert and Howard Hodgkin have been associated with the institution. In the post-war era, it relocated to Corsham Court and became a significant player in the English Modernist movement .

Why Bath Spa University

  • International Engagement: The university is committed to fostering global connections through its International Strategy, which includes initiatives like GALA, Go Global, and European Projects. These programs aim to enhance teaching and research by embedding international perspectives across all activities .
  • Student Support and Wellbeing: Bath Spa University prioritizes student wellbeing, offering services that address mental health, disability support, and financial guidance. The Student Wellbeing Services provide resources to help students navigate university life successfully .
  • Sustainability and Values: The university embraces a strong environmental ethos, with students and staff actively contributing to high environmental standards. Their commitment to sustainability is evident through various initiatives and a dedicated climate pledge .
bath-spa-university.accommodation:
Bath Spa University offers a range of accommodation options to suit different student needs, including on-campus residences at Newton Park and city-based halls like Charlton Court, Waterside Court, and Twerton Mill. These accommodations feature en-suite rooms, studios, and shared living spaces, with easy access to university campuses and local amenities. The university also provides tailored support for students with specific requirements through its Priority Halls scheme, ensuring accessible and inclusive living environments. For those preferring private housing, Bath Spa offers guidance and tools like the Student Pad platform and community groups to help students find suitable off-campus accommodation.

For more details kindly refer to the website :- https://www.bathspa.ac.uk/student-life/accommodation/

birmingham-city-university.about:
The Birmingham City University offers a range of subjects and specialisms across six Schools – Arts; Business; Law and Social Sciences; Architecture, Built Environment, Computing and Engineering; Life and Health Sciences; and Nursing and Midwifery – as well as the Royal Birmingham Conservatoire. The university’s early history can be traced back to 1843 with the founding of the Birmingham Society of Arts and School of Design. Over time, five individual colleges were brought together to form The City of Birmingham Polytechnic in 1971, which later became Birmingham City University.

With around 31,000 students from 100 countries (HESA Student Record 2021/22 © Higher Education Statistics Agency Limited), Birmingham City University is recognised as a large and diverse institution. The university places students at the centre of its activities, focusing on providing them with the best opportunities for future success.

Why Birmingham City University (BCU)

  • Industry-Standard Facilities: BCU has invested over £500 million across its campuses and facilities. The university’s developments include the state-of-the-art Parkside Building, which houses four film and TV studios, and the simulated operating theatre and hospital wards at the City South Campus. These investments aim to provide students with the best possible learning environments.
  • International Scholarships: BCU provides a variety of undergraduate and postgraduate scholarship opportunities for international students, aimed at supporting them throughout their studies.
  • Employability Support: While studying in the UK, students at BCU have the opportunity to gain valuable, paid work experience through flexible on-campus jobs. Many courses also include the option of completing an industry placement, providing practical experience and helping students develop skills relevant to their future careers. The BCU award recognises students’ extracurricular achievements, demonstrating to employers that they possess more than just academic qualifications.
  • At The Heart Of A Vibrant, Diverse City: Located in the heart of the United Kingdom, Birmingham provides an ideal setting for students. The city offers a vibrant atmosphere with lively street markets, a wide variety of restaurants, and numerous sports and entertainment venues, ensuring there is something to suit every interest. As BCU is centrally located within the city of Birmingham, it offers an extensive range of accommodation options, providing students with a variety of choices to suit their preferences and needs.

birmingham-city-university-international.about:
Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC) offers students an entry point to a wide range undergraduate and postgraduate degrees, many of which include opportunities for work placements. Students receive academic and language training and support that will prepare them for success in their progression degree. Pathway subjects include: Architecture, Art & Design, Business, Engineering, Fashion, Media, Sport Management and more!

BCUIC is located in the heart of Birmingham, right next to the university's City Centre campus and offers several accommodation options that are only a few minutes' walk from the campus. Once enrolled at BCUIC, students also gain full access to the university's facilities.

Why University of Plymouth International College

  • Campus: Birmingham City University comprises three main campuses, with additional sites located throughout the city – including one of the largest jewelry schools in the world.
  • Facilities: Students can find the latest in spaces, equipment, and technology that will support their learning, such as the £8.5 million sports center, with an 80-station fitness suite and 8-court sports hall, new specialist laboratories for Health and Life Sciences, the CITY trading room which uses the same investment analysis software as traders and financial analysts, and more!
  • Location: Located right in the center of the UK, Birmingham is the country's second-largest city, with under 25s accounting for nearly 40% of its population - an ideal destination for students! Also, rent prices in Birmingham are more than 50% lower than in London, making it a more affordable place to live, study, and explore.
  • Global industry links: BCU works with big-name employers like the BBC, the NHS, Jaguar Land Rover, Cisco, Microsoft and the Royal Shakespeare Company.
  • High employment rate: Birmingham City University has been ranked 7th in the UK for employability and 97% of students are in employment or further study within six months of graduating (DLHE Survey 2016/17).

bournemouth-university.about:
Bournemouth University is an innovative and vibrant public university located in Bournemouth, Dorset, a coastal town famous for its seven-mile stretch of sandy beaches. The town of Bournemouth has a population of roughly 500,000 and is a thriving hub for several industries including the creative, financial, and tourism sectors. Bournemouth University boasts a strong student community with over 19,000 students and more than 2,600 international students. Bournemouth University offers students many innovative and industry-focused programs, with particular strengths in media and communication and technology. Students will benefit from close ties to industry and many of BU's programs offer industry accreditation or placements with over 1,500 industry partners.

Talbot Campus is the main campus for Bournemouth University and hosts the main University buildings including the student union and the main library. It has had many recent updates (2017-2018) and is a self-contained campus located on the boundary of Bournemouth and Poole.

Why Bournemouth University - Talbot

  • Campus: Talbot Campus is the main campus for Bournemouth University, and has many of the flagship facilities including the Sir Michael Cobham Library, and the Student Centre.
  • Economic Region: Bournemouth is home to UK's fastest growing digital economy, and one of the UK's largest financial centres outside of London.
  • Facilities: Talbot Campus houses the main library and student union, alongside SportBU - a fully equipped sport centre and gym.
  • Culture: Bournemouth is a cosmopolitan, student-friendly town with a relaxed, beach-side lifestyle. Bournemouth is home to AFC Bournemouth, one of England's newest Premiership football teams and BU's official sport partner.

Note: Document verification is mandatory for all applicants applying to Bournemouth University.

Bournemouth University International College offers pathway courses and Pre-Sessional English programmes in partnership with Bournemouth University, and is located on the University campus. The College is the ideal setting for degree preparation. Students will benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and expert teaching, as well as comfortable accommodation attached to the College building as students start their path degree success. Bournemouth University is creative, enterprising and international. Located on England’s beautiful south coast, it has state-of-the-art facilities that help students get the most from their studies. 39 nationalities were represented by new students at the College in 2020.

Bournemouth University International College has 3 main types of pathway course: Foundation Certificate, International Year One and Pre-Master’s. The College also offers Pre-Sessional English courses if students already meet BU’s academic entry requirements.

Why Bournemouth University International College (Kaplan International Pathways)

  • Location: Bournemouth is a seaside town with 11km of sandy beaches and beautiful surrounding countryside. The College's convenient location is ideal for shopping and socializing with friends, playing outdoor sports, and visiting local attractions.
  • Staff Support: Bournemouth's friendly staff help students with every aspect of student life, both inside and outside the classroom, and organize many different activities, events and trips for students to enjoy.
  • Outstanding Accommodation: The College building gives students the ideal study abroad experience. As well as excellent learning and social facilities, the College has its own student residence on the upper floors, with stylish, modern apartments offering privacy and comfort.

brunel-university-london-pathway-college.about:
Brunel University London Pathway College is designed to meet the needs of students by offering world-class pathway programs leading to undergraduate and postgraduate degrees at Brunel University London. At undergraduate level, this pathway college offers University Foundation and First year University Studies for candidates who do not meet the direct entry criteria or hold high school qualifications that are not recognized. At postgraduate level, Brunel University London Pathway College provides the highly acclaimed Pre-Master's program leading to an excellent range of Brunel University London Master programs in business and management, computing, engineering & design and arts.

Brunel University London Pathway College is located inside Brunel University London Campus, so students will experience university student life from day one. and they will have access to all of university facilities. Brunel University London Pathway College is there to support students for their future academic and professional careers. Brunel is a single site university where students can take part in a diverse range of clubs and societies for an action-packed social life. Everything is within a 10-minute walk - whether students are going to a class or for a coffee, whether they want a place to eat or a space to meet, it's all close by!

Why Brunel University London Pathway College?

  • Facilities and Safety: Located inside Brunel University London. Students are offered a safe, friendly and positive environment where they benefit from high-quality teaching, recreation and sporting facilities.
  • Location: Campus is well-connected. Just a short walk away, the town of Uxbridge offers students everything they need to shop, entertain and socialize, with central London just a tube ride away.
  • Employability: Students can develop a wide range of employability skills and improve their career prospects, with the help of the University's Professional Development service. Brunel’s careers service is rated the 5th best careers service in the country (Student Hut Survey, 2019).
  • Pathways: All pathway programs offer smaller class sizes for greater individual attention, of up to 30 students per class.
  • Placements: Over 95% of Brunel University London undergraduate courses offer a placement, giving students the opportunity to gain invaluable work experience.

cu-coventry.about:
Study for a degree from one of the UK’s leading universities in an inspirational setting! CU Coventry, part of the Coventry University Group, offers a style of education that is flexible and designed to fit around students' lives. Students can choose from a wide range of vocational, career-focused courses and study at a pace that suits them. CU Coventry students benefit from a modern, forward-thinking higher education institution, reinforced by the quality and reputation of Coventry University. All courses are awarded and accredited by Coventry University, which means that students receive a Coventry University qualification upon graduation.

In March 2019, Coventry opened its state-of-the-art £33m campus in the city to enhance the university's innovative education model and provide students with a cutting-edge learning environment. The building has been designed to enable collaboration, creativity and innovation to flourish and features teaching rooms, IT suites, engineering and science labs, a moot court and café, as well as extensive breakout areas for social learning to make teaching more flexible.

Why CU Coventry

  • Flexible Start Dates and Small Class Sizes: CU Coventry aims to makes higher education accessible for international students by offering competitively-priced courses with numerous intakes throughout the year, small class sizes for higher levels of support, and ongoing English language support.
  • Highly-ranked University: Shortlisted for University of the Year - The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021.
  • Teaching Excellence: Awarded Gold for Teaching and Learning Excellence by the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2017.
  • Focus on Employability: CU Coventry students are taught by lecturers who are experts in their field, making them career-ready with the skills to succeed upon graduation. 97% are employed or enrolled in further study within 6 months of graduation (DLHE survey, UG UK, 2016/17).
  • Location: Coventry is a vibrant and diverse student city, located in the center of the UK and only 1 hour from London by train. The city’s rich history and heritage sees world famous sites like Coventry Cathedral and St Mary’s Guildhall sit alongside exciting newer developments like Coventry Transport Museum, Fargo Village and a host of shops, restaurants, entertainment and nightlife venues.

cu-scarborough.about:
CU Scarborough's state-of-the-art, purpose-built campus opened in September 2016. Students at CU Scarborough have access to all the facilities they need to support their studies and student life, all located in a modern, open-plan campus. At CU Scarborough, there is an emphasis on high levels of support for students, who are taught in small classes and have weekly tutorials in groups of no more than 5. Furthermore, international students have access to English lessons throughout the academic year as opposed to solely pre-sessional offered at comparing institutions. Tutors are also on hand for any additional support students may require.

CU Scarborough is continuously expanding its courses, which means its building is ever-changing. The new £50m sport and education campus, which also features the Scarborough Sports Village and Flamingo Land Football Stadium, is home to the Scarborough Athletic Football Club. September 2018 saw the first cohort of Adult Nursing students begin their degree in the new clinical-skills lab and in September 2019 a brand new drama studio was opened to accommodate Acting students. CU Scarborough has gone from housing just 17 students in 2015, to over 600 students in 2019 and they are not stopping there!

  • Teaching Excellence: Awarded Gold for Teaching and Learning Excellence by the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2017.

  • Location: Scarborough is located on the beautiful North Yorkshire Coast with stunning scenery and glorious beaches. The growing town is rich with history and celebrates a wide variety of cultural and recreational activities (including festivals for surfing, science fiction, jazz music and more), making it a great student town for getting involved with the local community.

canterbury-christ-church-university.about:
Canterbury Christ Church University (CCCU) started out as a teacher training college in the 1960s in response to a national shortage of teachers. Today they continue to shape their courses and research around critical social issues both nationally and globally. In 2022, they celebrated their Diamond Jubilee, marking 60 years of making a positive difference to people’s lives, through education, research and innovation. From teacher training in the early 1960s, adding professional health courses in the 80s, and now new creative arts, science, engineering, technology and medicine for future generations, their story is one of relevance, impact and progress.

InUni, a part of the Global University Systems (GUS) and one of the leading global education partners to help institutions attract diverse and quality students, across the globe. They aim to democratise the world through higher education, and partner with universities to offer customised, quality-focused and end-to-end solutions to meet their specific needs.

Why Canterbury Christ Church University?

  • Location: Less than an hour from London, Canterbury is a lively student city with historic streets, ancient city walls and a vibrant atmosphere. The Medway Campus is in an area known as Chatham Maritime, a student-friendly quarter.
  • Facilities: A multi-million pound investment is transforming the University, including a centre for science, technology, health, and engineering. CCCU also home to the Kent and Medway Medical School and a stunning creative arts facility.
  • Student Support: Canterbury Christ Church University want to give students the best possible experience, from registration to graduation. The services are available to support students at whatever point they are in their university journey. Study support, money management, wellbeing support and more, CCCU is committed to working with students to ensure they reach their full potential.

cardiff-metropolitan-university.about:
Founded in 1865 and located in the capital of Wales, Cardiff Metropolitan University delivers professionally recognised degrees, together with impactful research and innovation, in art and design, business and management, education and public services, sport and health sciences, and technologies and engineering. Whether students are lo​o​king for undergraduate​ or postgraduate study, Cardiff Metropolitan University is an excellent choice for international students choosing to study in the UK.​ The University has two campus locations; Llandaff and Cyncoed. Llandaff is the home of theCardiff School of Sport & Health Sciences (Llandaff), Cardiff School of Management, ​​​Cardiff School of Technologies and the ​​​Cardiff School of Art & Design​ while Cyncoed is home to the Cardiff School of Education & Social Policy and the Cardiff School of Sport & Health Sciences.

Cardiff Metropolitan is a collaborative and compassionate community, their values of creativity, diversity, freedom and innovation are lived through the behaviours of their staff and students; by their leadership, trust, courage and accountability to each other, and to their partners. The school is home to approximately 11,000 students, with over 1200 international students from more than 143 countries. International students are value​d and respected for the unique experiences and perspectives that they contribute to university life, enriching the study experience for all students.

All bedrooms are mixed gender and inclusive of all utility bills, including electric, gas, water, internet, insurance, etc. In addition, Cardiff Met also allocates just over 1,100 private en-suite halls to students through nomination agreements with private halls located near to the campuses.

There are two Cardiff Met-owned halls of residence which are conveniently located to accommodate students studying on any of the two campuses. Rooms at Plas Gwyn halls are allocated to students studying at the Llandaff Campus and rooms at Cyncoed halls are allocated to students studying at the Cyncoed Campus.

The Plas Gwyn campus is located in the small, pleasant cathedral 'city' of Llandaff, which is approximately two miles from Cardiff city centre and walking distance from the Llandaff Campus. All of the single study bedrooms are self-catered and have en suite bathroom facilities.

imperial-college-london.about:
The Imperial College of Science, Technology and Medicine, known by its trade names Imperial College London and Imperial, is a public research university in London, England. Its history began with Prince Albert, husband of Queen Victoria, who envisioned South Kensington as a cultural district with museums, colleges, and the Royal Albert Hall. In 1907, two colleges – the Royal College of Science and the Royal School of Mines – merged to form Imperial College London, with City and Guilds College joining in 1910.

In 1988, Imperial merged with St Mary's Hospital Medical School and then with Charing Cross and Westminster Medical School to form the Imperial College School of Medicine. The Imperial Business School was established in 2003 and was officially opened by Queen Elizabeth II. Formerly a constituent college of the University of London, Imperial became an independent university in 2007.

Imperial is organised into four faculties: engineering, medicine, natural sciences, and business. The university encourages innovation and enterprise across all its faculties by integrating business courses into science degrees and providing business students with a scientific education. The main campus is located in South Kensington with additional campuses in White City and other locations near South Kensington. The faculty of medicine also operates five teaching hospitals across London as well as the Pears Cumbria School of Medicine based in Carlisle in co-operation with the University of Cumbria.

Its graduates and academics include 14 Nobel Prize winners, three Fields Medal winners, 74 fellows of the Royal Society and 84 fellows of the Royal Academy of Engineering.

kings-college-london.about:
King's College London (informally King's or KCL) is a public research university in London, England. King's was established by royal charter in 1829 under the patronage of King George IV and the Duke of Wellington. In 1836, King's became one of the two founding colleges of the University of London. It is one of the oldest university-level institutions in England.

King's grew in the late 20th century through a series of mergers and reincorporations, including the reincorporation of its medical and dental school in 1983, mergers with Queen Elizabeth College and Chelsea College of Science and Technology in 1985 and the Institute of Psychiatry in 1997, and the merger of the United Medical and Dental Schools of Guy's and St Thomas' Hospitals in 1998. Plans for a merger with Cranfield University were announced in May 2026.

King's operates across five main campuses: the historic Strand Campus in central London, three other Thames-side campuses (Guy's, St Thomas' and Waterloo) nearby, and a campus in Denmark Hill in south London. It also has a presence in Shrivenham, Oxfordshire, for professional military education, and in Newquay, Cornwall, which is where King's information service center is based. The academic activities are organized into nine faculties, which are subdivided into numerous departments, centers, and research divisions. In 2024/25, King's reported total income of £1.377 billion, of which £260.5 million was from research grants and contracts. It has the fourth largest endowment of any university in the UK, and the largest of any in London. King's is the sixth-largest university in the UK by total enrolment and receives over 68,000 undergraduate applications per year.

King's is a member of a range of academic organizations including the Association of Commonwealth Universities, the European University Association, and the Russell Group. King's is home to the Medical Research Council's MRC Centre for Neurodevelopmental Disorders and is a founding member of the King's Health Partners academic health sciences centre, Francis Crick Institute and MedCity. By total enrolment, it is the largest European centre for graduate and post-graduate medical teaching and biomedical research, including the world's first nursing school, the Florence Nightingale Faculty of Nursing and Midwifery. King's is generally regarded as part of the "golden triangle" of universities located in and about Oxford, Cambridge and London. King's has typically enjoyed royal patronage by virtue of its foundation; King Charles III reaffirmed patronage in May 2024.

Alumni and staff of King's or institutions that later merged with King's include 14 Nobel Prize laureates; heads of states, governments and intergovernmental organisations; 21 current members of the House of Commons, two Speakers of the House of Commons and 12 current members of the House of Lords; and the recipients of three Oscars.

Kingston University takes great pride in the difference they make in the lives of their over 18,000 students and the wider community they serve. They are constantly striving to provide excellent services and continue to make a positive contribution to the economic, social, and cultural life of the borough.

  • Location: Kingston Upon Thames has an excellent public transportation system, with two mainline train stations, bus routes and major motorways nearby, making it easy to get around the city and country. Roehampton Vale campus is located just three miles from Kingston town centre, with easy access by public transport.
  • Extracurricular Activities: The Roehampton Vale campus is designed to provide teaching rooms and laboratories exclusively for engineering students. This engineering focus gives it a real sense of community. There is no shortage of clubs, societies and volunteer organizations to join that bring people of common interests, faiths and ethnic backgrounds together.
  • Facilities: Roehampton Vale campus has wind tunnels, a range of vehicles, a flight simulator and a Learjet plane. The labs include a composite material fabrication lab; materials testing equipment and rapid prototyping machinery; and computer-aided simulation technologies. Kingston University also have the latest CFD, CAM and CAD software, plus an embedded system laboratory with National Instruments equipment. The learning resources centre includes engineering-specific resources and databases, as well as a cafe.
  • Accommodation: The University offers international students a range of high quality halls to choose from, all of which have single-study bedrooms arranged in flats with self-catering kitchens.

It received university status in 2005 and currently offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses in a wide variety of disciplines. The university consist of nine departments ranging from Hope School of Business to the School of Health Sciences. Liverpool Hope University pursues a path of excellence in scholarship and collegial life without reservation or hesitation. The University’s distinctive philosophy is to ‘educate in the round’ – mind, body and spirit – in the quest for Truth, Beauty and Goodness.

The university comprises of two campuses: The Hope Park located in Childwall and the Creative Campus located in Everton. The campuses both have renowned libraries and prominent halls of residence tailored for different types of students. The Sheppard-Worlock Library located in the main campus of Hope Park offers students access to a wide array of publications, research materials, extensive computing facilities, and even hosts a number of commercial business activities. Recently, the university has also been focusing on enhancing its research abilities in key areas such as education, humanities, mathematics social sciences and robotics. The research projects of the university have earned a strong reputation for their active engagement with the public at local, national and international levels.

Why Liverpool Hope University

  • Location: Liverpool is a city like no other. From world-famous architecture and magnificent museums, to music legends revolutionising popular culture, Liverpool has always been a hub of creativity. Through spectacular festivals, dramatic sporting attractions and unique art, the city continues to be a gateway for UK culture, attracting millions of visitors every year.
  • Campus and Amenities: As a campus-based University, students could be studying in the leafy suburb of the Hope Park campus or in the vibrant Creative Campus, just ten minutes outside of the city centre. There is also a residential campus, Aigburth Park, and an outdoor education centre in North Wales. With beautiful grounds and amazing facilities, students will have a home away from home at Liverpool Hope University.
  • Academic Options: Liverpool Hope University offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate taught, and postgraduate research degrees. From fine art to music, accounting to history, physical education to biology, there is something for everyone.

The London campus has diversified and expanded the high quality education offered by Loughborough to both postgraduate students and those looking to advance their professional development.

Students at Loughborough have access to a truly global experience, where they are taught by academics from across the world; they can study abroad or complete an overseas placement, and have numerous opportunities to learn a new language.   • Facilities: Loughborough University is a 440 acre, single-site campus that includes open spaces, gardens, sports pitches, world-class sports facilities, a state-of-the-art STEM lab, residences, dining halls, cafes, and more.

Driven by industry standards and supported by the latest high-performance technology, they produce highly employable and enterprising graduates. Ravensbourne has a strong track record in graduate employability and business creation.

Ravensbourne also hosts alongside its student community more than 100 creative technology businesses that utilise its leading edge technologies and media resources, and collaborate with its student body and industry partners. Students are professional creatives from the day they join the university. Ravensbourne works in close partnership with employers to foster the mindsets and skillsets that the creative industries need.

  • Location: Ravensbourne is located at the heart of London’s newest permanent creative community on the Greenwich Peninsula. Thanks to recent investment, this stretch of London riverside has gone from marshy bog-land to a thriving public space, filled with creative businesses, a 3km art trail, restaurants, cafes, hotels and entertainment juggernaut, the O2 arena.
  • Student Services: Ravensbourne supports its students, from specialist tutoring and mentoring, to counselling and career services.
  • Campus Life: Students can expect plenty of events throughout the year both on and off campus, linked to campaigns such as Go Green Week, Fairtrade Fortnight, Children in Need, Sports Relief and Mental Health Day.

Regent College London was formed in 2010 as part of  Regent Group, an education, training, and investment management business founded by the Pankaj family. They share a rich and successful history in education, characterised by compact campuses, small, focused classes, and unparalleled support. The college initially opened in Wembley, delivering BTEC Higher National Diplomas and providing students with alternative progression routes into Higher Education. In 2013, they opened admissions to the public to reflect their commitment to widening access and participation. Since then, they have been delivering a range of HND business programmes validated by Pearson. They have also expanded their Higher Education provision, working with a collection of university partners to deliver Foundation Year Routes, Foundation Degrees, Bachelor’s Degrees, Top-up Degrees, and Master’s Degrees.

As a college, they have achieved many goals, such as a positive outcome for QAA Higher Education Review, excellent results in the National Student Survey, opening five campus locations across London, and of course, helping its students achieve their lifelong goals and aspirations.

Why Regent College London (in partnership with University of Greater Manchester)?

  • Partner University: Regent College London (RCL) is the London academic centre for the University of Greater Manchester. International students studying at RCL will graduate with a University of Greater Manchester degree. The University of Greater Manchester prides itself on being a teaching-intensive, research-informed institution and was recently awarded an overall Silver rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework 2023, with a Gold rating in Student Experience. The University of Greater Manchester is a modern university with a distinguished history and has a long and proud heritage that goes back to 1825.
  • Campus Locations: Regent College London have multiple campus locations across London which are home to experienced teachers, thriving communities and inspiring learning resources. Each study location is close to transport links and boasts modern facilities with intelligent and cutting-edge technology, providing everything students need throughout their student journey with them.
  • Careers and Employability Support: Whether students are looking to career transition, progress in their chosen sector or start a business, the Regent Careers team are there to support them every step of the way. The College offer career support throughout students' studies and even after they graduate where they can continue to access workshops, resources and individualised support through their lifelong Alumni Association.
  • Wellbeing and Support: Regent College London is committed to supporting students' wellbeing and providing supportive services alongside their studies. The Student Support team is here to provide confidential and personalised assistance tailored to students' individual needs. Whether they need help with academic challenges, mental health support, or guidance on personal matters, the team is there to support students at every step of the way. Collaboration with external organisations, such as Student Finance England, to provide guidance on support services like Student Disability Allowance( DSA) and Child Care Allowance as well.

The school offers small class sizes and a personal experience, which is an excellent fit for international students choosing to study overseas for the first time. Core program offerings span a wide variety of disciplines including Business and Management, Fashion and Design, Liberal Arts and Humanities, Film, Media and Performance, and Psychology.

Regent's has one of the most diverse student bodies across the entirety of the UK, attracting 80 percent of its students from over 137 different countries outside of the UK. With the ethos of developing tomorrow's global leaders, Regent's offers exclusive networking opportunities for students seeking an international education. Other cultural and cross-cultural elective modules are available to all students, providing the opportunity to develop language skills, cultural agility and internationalism, whilst enhancing and personalising their professional profiles.

Why Regent's University London

  • Location: Located in the heart of London, students will find themselves immersed with plenty of opportunities outside of the classroom. London has a world-class arts and culture, fashion, and entertainment scene. As well, Regent's University London is located in the heart of Regent's Park, one of the Royal Parks of London, offering a tranquil and secure setting for students.
  • Small Class Sizes: With an average class size of 14 students and a 13:1 student to staff ratio, Regent's faculty staff understand and guide each students on their individual academic journeys.
  • Emphasis on Internationalization: Regent's University London is a truly global institution whose student body is 80 percent international, coming from over 137 different countries outside of the UK. With the ethos of developing tomorrow's global leaders, Regent's offers exclusive networking opportunities for students who are seeking an international education.
  • Facilities: Nearly one-third of Regent's graduates start their own businesses within six months of graduation. The school's award-winning entrepreneurial space, The Hive, provides a support system with excellent guidance, ranging from how to take a unique idea and create a business plan to how to expand a business into new markets. As well as providing workshops on CV preparation and interview skills, The Hive provides a hub for internship and placement opportunities.

NOTE: This school may use UCAS as an external portal for application for some undergraduate programs. A £20 (single application) or £26 (up to 5 applications) application fee may apply.

Students can join societies, start their own clubs, or get involved in campaigning for a better future as an associate member of the Students’ Union.

universal-higher-education.about:
Universal Higher Education UK (UHE UK) is a London-based higher education study centre operated as part of the Oxford International Education Group network. UHE UK delivers undergraduate and postgraduate higher education programmes in partnership with established UK universities, including the University of Roehampton and the University of Bradford. Its programmes are designed to provide students with recognised UK qualifications alongside a supportive, career-focused learning experience.

UHE UK has a diverse international student community and focuses on accessible teaching, small class sizes and personalised academic support. Students can benefit from guidance from tutors and student-support staff throughout their studies, helping them build academic knowledge, confidence and career-ready skills.

Why Universal Higher Education UK?

  • Supportive Learning Environment:UHE UK focuses on a student-centred learning experience with small class sizes and accessible tutors. Academic and student-support teams help students settle into their studies, remain engaged and make progress towards their academic goals.
  • International Student Community: UHE UK welcomes students from around the world, creating a multicultural learning environment where students can interact with people from different countries and backgrounds. The institution highlights its international community as an important part of the student experience.
  • Recognised UK University Partnerships: UHE UK delivers programmes in partnership with established UK universities. Undergraduate programmes are designed and awarded by the University of Roehampton, while postgraduate programmes are designed and awarded by the University of Bradford.

university-of-aberdeen-international-stu.about:
The University of Aberdeen International Study Centre is located at the heart of the historic King’s College Campus. It offers a full range of subject options and pathways, including tailored programs in engineering and medical studies.

The UK’s fifth oldest university, Aberdeen has been offering life-changing learning opportunities for more than 500 years. Today, it adds to this rich heritage with modern facilities and a 21st-century outlook. Represented by 130 nationalities, the University has an international community and is committed to equality and diversity.

The University of Aberdeen strives to be one of the world’s top research-intensive universities. Associated with five Nobel Prize winners, it is known for learning and research excellence. Students at Aberdeen benefit from a personalized experience and flexible learning. Honours students receive a broad and flexible education within the Scottish four-year degree system.

Why the University of Aberdeen

  • History: Aberdeen is among the UKs ancient univiersities, with a founding date in 1495.
  • Campus: Aberdeen boasts impressive facilities both inside and outside of the classroom - and features a blend of historic and modern buildings.
  • Facilities: Students will benefit from access to world class facilities including the Sir Duncan Rice Library, and Aberdeen Sports Village.
  • Culture: With students from more than 130 nations represented on campus, the University of Aberdeen boasts a strong multicultural community, and international students will benefit from both the international community as well as Scotland's own distinct culture.

university-of-birmingham.about:
From 1900 to the present day, the University of Birmingham has been at the forefront of both national and international research, leading the way in making ground-breaking progress in areas that span industries such as gene structure, medicine, space research and communications. For more than a century, the University of Birmingham has been pursuing and sharing knowledge through outstanding teaching and world-leading research. A global reputation, quality learning and teaching, excellent facilities, a stunning campus and great city are some of the reasons making the University of Birmingham a great place to study and live.

The University of Birmingham is the original ‘redbrick’ University, part of the prestigious Russell Group; their thriving student population enjoys a wide range of courses, and exceptional campus and research facilities. Their heritage as the original ‘redbrick’ is combined with one of the most compelling and ambitious agendas in higher education. The University of Birmingham has been transformed in recent years, characterised by major investments in academic staffing, investment of £1 billion in campus facilities, strong and improving outcomes for their students, annual growth in research performance, and bold new moves.

The 10 Nobel Laureates the University of Birmingham counts among their staff and alumni have contributed to some of science’s greatest discoveries, including in recent times the Higgs Boson and Gravitational Waves. The University of Birmingham's research provides innovative solutions to the challenges faced in their city, their region and across the globe.

As one of the most popular UK universities, offering diverse opportunities for study and research, the University of Birmingham encourages and empowers people to turn ideas into reality and make important things happen.

Why the University of Birmingham

  • Green and Spacious Campus: Students will discover themselves at a green and spacious campus university just minutes from the hustle and bustle of the UK's diverse and vibrant second city. The eyes of the world will be on Birmingham in 2022 when they host the Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games.
  • Campus Facilities: The University of Birmingham's physical estate is the largest single enabler for world-class teaching and research, and provides a fantastic student experience, covering 672 acres, with over 200 buildings of different ages, complexities, physical condition and use, ranging from grade one and two listed properties to brand new state-of-the-art learning and research spaces.
  • Centre of Culture: From museums to the blue plaque trail, the campus is brimming with things to do and learn about.

university-of-bradford.about:
Study at the University of Bradford to benefit from - and be part of - teaching and research that harnesses technology for the good of society. At the University of Bradford, students will learn from academic and industry experts who are shaping the future of their sectors, and they'll learn in world-class facilities - they’ve invested millions of pounds in high-tech learning environments, such as their motion capture studio and Bloomberg Trading Room. Many of the courses at the University of Bradford have professional, statutory or regulatory body accreditation or approval, giving students the best possible start to their career.

Students will find a diverse mix of people from different backgrounds, faiths, nationalities and ages all sharing the close-knit City Campus at the University of Bradford. The Times and Sunday Times have named the University of Bradford as the UK’s University of the Year for Social Inclusion 2020. This prestigious national award recognises Bradford’s outstanding impact on social inclusion that ensures all students, irrespective of their background, are supported to achieve their potential and go on to achieve success.

Why the University of Bradford

  • A Sustainable City Centre Campus: Students will find everything they need on City Campus. City Campus is compact, self contained, and located just minutes from the city centre. Not only is the campus central it’s sustainable. With buildings made from hemp, beehives with student beekeepers, and edible gardens, sustainable development is embedded in University life. The University of Bradford regularly wins awards for their environmental initiatives, and their new developments are amongst the most sustainable buildings of their kind. Their campus is ranked the 4th greenest in the world.
  • Accommodation: The Green is the accommodation recommended by the University of Bradford to their students. The Green is just a few minutes from the Students' Union, the library and morning lectures. It is also just a short walk away from the city centre and other local attractions. The Site Team and their Student Wardens organise social events, trips, competitions and games on and off site – so students will have plenty of opportunities to meet new people and make lots of friends. The apartments also cater for people with a wide range of disabilities
  • Arts and Culture: Bradford’s thriving arts scene, diverse multicultural influences and historic venues make it an exciting cultural centre. The University has its own theatre, gallery and music centre. They run an Arts on Campus programme which offers something for everyone, with regular film screenings, exhibitions, talks and events. There are also many student-led societies and clubs covering all kinds of cultural interests.
  • Sports and Fitness: Bradford is a really sporty city. The Team Bradford sporting community offers clubs and activities for every student. Students can get involved in a range of sports; from football to snowboarding, archery to athletics. They have fantastic sports facilities on campus including Unique Fitness and Lifestyle, which offers a swimming pool, a climbing wall, a fully equipped gym, regular classes and therapy sessions, and a multi-use sports hall.
  • Career and Employability Services: The University of Bradford’s Career and Employability Services offers comprehensive support for students in developing employability skills, finding placements, part-time jobs and graduate employment. This support doesn’t end at graduate, the University offers continued support for five years after graduation

The University of Bradford International College (UBIC) is an embedded college located in the centre of the University of Bradford in West Yorkshire, England. UBIC offers pathway programmes for international students to prepare them for undergraduate and postgraduate studies in the UK.

The pathway programmes offer students various routes to a degree. Depending on level of study, English language ability, and subject area, the first stages at Bradford may be through the following pathways:

  1. International Foundation Year (IFY)
  2. International Year Zero (IYZ)
  3. International Year One (IY1)
  4. International Incorporated Masters (IIM)

Why University of Bradford International College

  • Enhancing English skills: By studying at UBIC, students will improve their academic and English language skills. They will be prepared for their future studies at the University of Bradford, a top 25 UK university for graduate prospects (The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide, 2019).
  • Diverse community: UBIC was awarded the Queen's anniversary prize for higher and further education, continually providing high-quality academic teaching with industry expertise to a global community of over 130 different nationalities.
  • Research and teaching quality: University of Bradford is a technology with over 50 years of innovation and excellence. The university is a part of the World Technology Universities Network, and is silver rated in the Teaching Excellence Framework.

university-of-brighton.about:
University of Brighton is a progressive, modern school in one of Britain's most exciting, lively cities. It is career-focused with excellent facilities and business connections and, at its heart, it is an inventive institution with a creative spirit. The university offers degrees in a variety of subjects and its main campus, Moulsecoomb, is home to programs in applied sciences, architecture, business, law, and engineering. Over the last few years, this inspiring campus has undergone a significant transformation, and now features new residence halls and learning facilities, fitness and student union facilities, numerous green spaces, and an accessible pedestrian bridge that links both sides of campus.

A big part of the academic culture at University of Brighton is about unlocking each student's potential by empowering them to do something they really love and succeed at it. Degrees at Brighton are generally quite flexible, and students are often can choose optional modules, work placements and volunteering opportunities that work to their strengths.

Why University of Brighton?

  • Campus: Brighton's community is made up of students and staff from over 150 countries. There are more than 100 societies for students to expand their interests, meet like-minded people, and do something they love.
  • Facilities: The university has 4 campuses, all with superb facilities, including sports halls, a swimming pool, dance studios, a newsroom, Psychology labs, world-class Design Archives, and more!
  • Location: Brighton is a student-friendly, artistic, and bustling city with famous beaches and a diverse and inclusive community. It has an abundance of stores, green spaces, restaurants, bars, and entertainment options, and is a short train ride from London.
  • Placement Opportunities: An important part of many programs at Brighton is the opportunity for students to gain work or volunteer experience in a professional environment.
  • Professional Accreditation: The majority of students study programs that are accredited by professional and statutory bodies. Successful completion of a professionally accredited course indicates that the student has reached the occupational standard required to practice that profession.

university-of-buckingham.about:
The University of Buckingham combines academic excellence with independence in a supportive, student-focused environment. Founded on academic freedom, it nurtures a diverse international community, encouraging critical thinking through small-group tutorials instead of large lectures. Buckingham offers flexible pathways, including September and January starts, two-year undergraduate degrees, and 4.5-year Medicine programs, enabling faster graduation for postgraduate study or workforce entry. Since launching the UK’s first two-year degrees in 1983, it has refined its programs to provide the widest range of accelerated degrees in the country.

Ranked 1st for Lecturer and Teaching Quality and Student Support in Southeast England (WUSCAs 2025), Buckingham reflects a commitment to high-quality teaching and personalized care. Guided by a vision of academic freedom and a mission to inspire individuals through learning, research, and entrepreneurship, Buckingham equips students to become future leaders and innovators.

  • Two-Year Bachelor’s Degree: Innovative two-year programmes add an additional summer term, allowing students to complete the same teaching weeks as a traditional three-year degree without increased workload. Students can progress directly to a master’s programme, completing both degrees in three years.
  • Save Time and Money: The fast-tracked schedule enables students to graduate and enter the workforce up to a year earlier than at most universities, offering savings of around 20% compared to traditional courses.
  • Small Group Teaching: With smaller class sizes, students receive individual attention from personal tutors. Academics integrate their latest research into teaching, ensuring students graduate with current, industry-relevant knowledge. With about 2,700 students, the University fosters a close-knit environment.
  • Culture: Buckingham has a diverse community with students from over 100 nationalities, resembling a global village where cross-cultural connections thrive.
  • Values: Defined by independence and a distinctive ethos, Buckingham continues to uphold the principle of independent thinking established by its founders.
  • Location: Set in a picturesque riverside campus, the University is near a vibrant market town with easy access to shops, cafés, and excellent transport links, including Milton Keynes train station for fast connections to major cities. Students can join various clubs and societies catering to diverse interests.

From the centre at ONCAMPUS UK North, based on the campus of the University of Central Lancashire (UCLan), students are encouraged to develop the skills required for progression onto degree programmes at the best UK universities. With their partner UCLan, offering guaranteed progression (subject to achieving progression criteria), students can choose to continue onto a degree at UCLan or apply to any other UK university with help and support through the UCAS application process.

Situated in the heart of the North West of England the University of Central Lancashire (UCLan) is located in the city of Preston a vibrant, cultural and friendly city, located a short distance from the coastline, the Lake District, and the larger cities of Manchester and Liverpool, both of which have international airports.

Why University of Central Lancashire ONCAMPUS UK North Centre?

  • Guaranteed Progression: Through their partnership with UCLan, ONCampus is proud to prepare international students for success in their chosen degrees at UCLan or at other leading UK universities.
  • Medical Pathways: Medicine is one of the most competitive courses in the UK. Academic entry criteria are high and the interview process can be challenging, but every year thousands of international students are accepted into medical school. ONCAMPUS UK North offers a number of routes to medicine through their partner institutions.
  • Location: An ideal study destination, located in the quiet city of Preston, allowing students to focus on their studies whilst offering close proximity to the major cities of Manchester and Liverpool.
  • Accommodation: ONCAMPUS UK North has a range of accommodation on offer just minutes away from campus, including University-owned halls of residence and private student halls.
  • Excellent Higher Education: UCLan is ranked in the top 3.3% of universities in the world (Center for World University Rankings, CWUR, 2017) and over 95.5% of graduates are employed or enter further study within six months of graduation (HESA, 2018).

university-of-chester.about:
With 15,000 students from 130 countries worldwide, The University of Chester provides a vibrant, diverse and safe home for international students.

The university is one of the oldest higher education providers in the United Kingdom having recently celebrated its 180th year of teaching, starting off as a teacher training college back in 1839. Originally based on one campus in Chester, the university now offers more than 200 single and combined honour’s programmes across a number of specialist sites in Chester, Shrewsbury and Warrington. Courses have an emphasis on practical learning to enhance prospects via industry placements or overseas opportunities, ranging from five-weeks to one-year.

Following more than 41,000 student reviews across 150 UK Universities, the University of Chester finished second in the best for international students' category at the 2020 WhatUni? Student Choice Awards. This national recognition, voted for by current international students, is testament to the university’s commitment to providing international students with the very best experience and support.

Why University of Chester - Queen's Park Campus, Chester

  • Award-Winning:Chester Business School was named joint Business School of the Year at the Educate North Awards in 2018 and was also shortlisted for Business School of the Year at the 2018 Times Higher Education Awards in recognition of the way the staff make a positive impact on the student experience. The focus of the Business School is to develop students by bringing real-world experience into the classroom. Chester’s nationally acclaimed Work Based Learning module also provides unrivalled opportunities for students to gain real workplace experience.
  • Links with Industry: The University of Chester has excellent links with respected industry leaders who often visit the University to share professional insights and stories of their own business experiences. This creates the opportunity for students to network with like-minded people and potential future employers. Chester also has links to global employers, that in recent years have provided placement opportunities with the world-famous cruise line Royal Caribbean International and Walt Disney World in Florida.
  • Hidden History: Queen’s Park Campus was once the Western Command headquarters for the Army during World War Two; not something you come across everyday! In its secret wartime bunkers, Churchill, Eisenhower and de Gaulle reputedly made many important strategic decisions – making Queen’s Park Campus a fitting location for world-class leaders of the future to flourish.

university-of-chichester.about:
The University of Chichester has a long history of higher education, having celebrated their 180th anniversary in 2019. Set across two beautiful campuses. the school has been providing education on its Bishop Otter Campus since 1839 and its Bognor Regis campus has provided teacher training since the 1940s. Today, the Bishop Otter Campus is home to the majority of the university's academic areas including Sports, Law, Humanities, Art, Theatre and Dance, as well as their highly ranked BSc (hons) Psychology programmes, currently Top 20 in the Guardian league table. Bognor Regis campus is home to other key subject areas including Business, Computing, Education and Maths, Engineering and Product Design and Creative Industry programmes.

The school is known for helping students achieve their aspirations through high-quality, personalised teaching and excellent student support - students are known by name here and not just a number. Teaching at the University of Chichester is informed and influenced by the research, professional practice, innovation, and enterprise activity undertaken by the staff. This school has a long tradition of working with international students and understands the needs of those studying away from their home countries and cultures. All programmes are designed with international students in mind and there are several programmes and academic services available especially for them.

Why University of Chichester

  • Campus life: Thanks to the University of Chichester's inclusive community, it has been named the 4th best UK university for student welfare and it is in the UK's top 10 for student experience.
  • Facilities: The university features collaborative working spaces, chill-out zones, a state-of-the-art Tech Park and has a world-class sports and recreation centre.
  • City: Chichester is a thriving city with good public transit and many culture and entertainment options. It is perfectly located for exploring the UK's south coast, with the beach nearby and London just a 90 minute train ride away!
  • Student support: The school is ranked 5th out of 131 higher education institutions in the UK for student support. It has a wide range of specialist support services to aid students through challenging times and have the best university experience.

NOTE: This school may use UCAS as an external portal for application for some programs. A £20 (single application) or £25 (up to 5 applications) application fee may apply.

The University of Cumbria is a place of possibility, where amazing journeys happen. Where it’s safe for students to be brave, to be boldly themselves. Cumbria offers exciting research-informed academic studies, professionally focused courses and technical skills so students can achieve their future career ambitions. They enrich their students so that they can realise their potential and achieve life-changing outcomes. That's why 97% of their graduates enter employment within 6 months of graduating.

Five campuses, one Cumbria, infinite possibility. Cumbria equips, empowers and inspires students to discover great things from the day they arrive. Whatever students want to be, Cumbria offers a wide range of degrees across health, sports, social work, teaching, business, law, science, conservation, outdoor studies, arts, creativity, tourism, policing and more. The University of Cumbria, where the impossible is made possible.

Why The University of Cumbria - Lancaster Campus

  • Facilities: Cumbria’s Lancaster Campus offers a friendly atmosphere and expert facilities from their sports complex to the student's unions to a library with space for students to focus. Lancaster also offers spaces for students to relax and socialise whether it's a coffee at Café Martineau or Lunch at The View.
  • Location: Set in beautiful parkland but only a 15 minute walk away from Lancaster city centre students can enjoy the campus atmosphere whilst having access to the vibrant and historic city of Lancaster. With its fair share of pubs and clubs, Lancaster has a lively music scene, as well as a selection of high street stores and independent boutiques for students to explore. Not to mention many other interesting cultural sightseeing opportunities!
  • National Park: Lancaster is in close proximity to the World-famous Lake District National Park with more than 200 mountains, 16 lakes, an abundance of rivers and rich habitats and wildlife. This idyll environment is a perfect place to spend time and enjoy the natural beauty of the North West.
